name: Add / remove emoji reaction on a message
uiSurface: long-press message action sheet with a row of emoji, plus tap-to-toggle on the reaction chip under the bubble; chat message list screen
rationale: TGClient already has reactTo:inChat:emoji: and renders a reaction summary line; only removeMessageReaction and a toggle path are missing, both one method each.

name: Set the full reaction set on a message at once (multi-reaction)
uiSurface: multi-select emoji sheet honouring max_reaction_count; chat screen
rationale: Single request with a vector of reactionType dictionaries; UI is an existing action sheet with selection state.

name: Big / animated reaction send flag
uiSurface: is_big flag on double-tap-to-react gesture; chat screen
rationale: Just passing is_big:YES; the server-side big effect matters to other clients, we simply cannot play the TGS animation locally.

name: Per-message available reactions (which emoji the user may use here)
uiSurface: populates the emoji row in the reaction picker, and shows a disabled state / reason label; chat screen
rationale: One request returning top/recent/popular lists that directly fill an existing horizontal emoji strip.

name: Reaction chips under a message bubble with counts and chosen state
uiSurface: new drawn row of rounded count chips inside the bubble layout, highlighted when is_chosen; chat message cell
rationale: Data is already parsed into a flat summary string, but real chips need bubble layout changes, hit testing and height recalculation in the frame-based message cell.

name: Reaction list — who reacted with what
uiSurface: paged table of avatar + name + emoji, opened from tapping a reaction chip; new modal list screen with per-emoji filter tabs
rationale: Needs a new paginated screen with offset-based loading and a filter segment, not just a row.

name: Global default (quick) reaction
uiSurface: a single settings row 'Quick reaction' opening an emoji chooser; Settings > Stickers/Emoji, plus double-tap gesture in chat
rationale: One setter, one update handler, one picker sheet; the double-tap gesture reuses addMessageReaction.

name: Recent reactions list and clearing it
uiSurface: 'Clear recent reactions' row with confirmation; Settings
rationale: Fire-and-forget request behind a confirmation alert.

name: Active emoji reactions catalogue and per-emoji metadata
uiSurface: backs the emoji picker grid; static_icon sticker downloaded and drawn as a small image
rationale: Usable, but each emojiReaction carries several TGS sticker files; we must fetch only static_icon and cache downscaled thumbnails to survive 512MB, which is real plumbing.

name: Animated reaction effects (appear/select/activate/around/effect animations)
uiSurface: full-screen overlay animation when a reaction is applied
rationale: All these assets are TGS (gzipped Lottie); there is no Lottie renderer for iOS 6 and a single-core A5 cannot render vector animation at frame rate — static icons only.

name: Custom emoji reactions
uiSurface: custom emoji tab inside the reaction picker; chat screen
rationale: Requires Telegram Premium to send, and the icons are animated custom-emoji stickers (TGS/WEBM) we cannot render; incoming ones can at best be shown as a generic star chip.

name: Unread reactions badge and jump-to-next-reaction
uiSurface: a small reaction badge button floating above the input bar that scrolls to the next unread reaction; chat screen, plus a count badge in the chat list row
rationale: Needs a new floating button, search-filter paging and update handling wired into the chat controller.

name: Mark all reactions in a chat as read
uiSurface: tap on the unread-reactions badge, or a chat-list swipe/long-press action
rationale: Single request, no response handling required.

name: Mark all reactions read in a forum topic / direct-messages topic
uiSurface: same badge inside a topic screen
rationale: Trivial calls, but only meaningful once forum topic and direct-messages-topic screens exist, which they do not.

name: Reaction notification settings (source, sound, preview)
uiSurface: a Reactions section in Notifications settings: two choice rows (messages / stories) with None-Contacts-All, a show-preview toggle, a sound row
rationale: Plain settings table plus one setter; values arrive via an update we can cache. Local notification display itself is out of scope.

name: Chat-level allowed reactions (admin)
uiSurface: admin screen: All / Some / Disabled selector, a checklist of emoji and a max-reactions-per-message stepper; group or channel settings
rationale: Needs a multi-select emoji checklist screen and a numeric picker, and correct construction of the two variant objects.

name: Moderation: delete another user's reactions
uiSurface: action-sheet items in the reaction list screen (long-press a reactor); reaction list
rationale: Two one-line requests gated on can_delete_reactions; only an action sheet is needed once the reaction list exists.

name: Report a reaction as spam
uiSurface: 'Report' item in the reaction-list action sheet
rationale: Single request behind an existing style of confirmation sheet.

name: Paid (star) reactions on channel posts
uiSurface: star burst slider sheet with an undo/commit timer and a sender-identity picker; channel post in chat
rationale: Sending requires a Telegram Stars balance topped up through in-app purchase, which we cannot perform on a sideloaded iOS 6 build; top paid reactors can only be shown read-only if we choose to.

name: Top paid reactors leaderboard on a post
uiSurface: small avatar row above the reaction chips on channel posts
rationale: Read-only and technically possible from data we already receive, but needs new avatar-row layout inside the message cell.

name: Story reactions
uiSurface: reaction bar in a story viewer, plus tappable suggested-reaction overlay areas
rationale: There is no story viewer on this client and stories themselves are out of reach on a 4S; the reaction calls are meaningless without it.

name: Live-story / group-call paid reactions
uiSurface: star-tap overlay during a live stream
rationale: Requires live-story group calls and a Stars balance, neither reachable here.

name: Saved Messages reaction tags
uiSurface: horizontal tag filter strip above Saved Messages, rename dialog on long-press
rationale: Tag filtering of Saved Messages is a Telegram Premium feature; without a subscription the tag strip is empty and setting labels fails server-side.

name: Reaction statistics graphs
uiSurface: chart view inside channel statistics
rationale: Modern clients render these graphs in a WebView-backed chart component; iOS 6 has only UIWebView and drawing these ourselves is disproportionate — treat as out of scope for reactions.

name: Topic list for a forum chat
uiSurface: Existing TGTopicsViewController table of topic rows, opened instead of the chat when chat.isForum
rationale: Already implemented, but the wrapper in TGClient.m forumTopicsForChat: uses stale field names (offset_message_thread_id / info.message_thread_id) while the current schema is offset_forum_topic_id / forum_topic_id, so paging and IDs must be corrected; also add is_closed, is_general, is_hidden, is_pinned, icon.color, icon.custom_emoji_id to the returned dict.

name: Topic list paging beyond 100
uiSurface: Infinite scroll on the topics table using next_offset_date/next_offset_message_id/next_offset_forum_topic_id
rationale: One extra wrapper taking the three offsets; the table already exists.

name: Search topics by name
uiSurface: UISearchBar header over the topics table, reusing the same call with a non-empty query
rationale: Same method, query parameter only; server-side filtering, no new plumbing.

name: Open a topic and read its history
uiSurface: TGChatViewController opened with a forumTopicId, title showing the topic name
rationale: Our chat controller currently loads history via chat-level calls; it needs a topic mode (separate history call, topic-scoped send/reply, topic-scoped read marking) which is real client plumbing.

name: Create a topic
uiSurface: Plus bar button on the topics screen opening a small compose screen: name field plus a row of six color swatches
rationale: Needs a new modal form screen with a color picker; the six allowed colors are fixed constants so no emoji picker is required for a first version.

name: Edit topic title and icon
uiSurface: Same create form reused in edit mode, reached from a long-press action sheet on a topic row
rationale: Shares the create screen; listed separately because permission gating (can_manage_topics, or creator) and the edit_icon_custom_emoji flag change the form's behaviour.

name: Close / reopen a topic
uiSurface: Action sheet item on a topic row, plus a locked composer bar inside a closed topic
rationale: One boolean call; the only UI is a TGActionSheet button and hiding the input bar when info.is_closed.

name: Hide / unhide the General topic
uiSurface: Action sheet item shown only on the row whose info.is_general is true
rationale: Single boolean call gated on is_general and can_manage_topics.

name: Pin / unpin topics and reorder pins
uiSurface: Action sheet item for pin/unpin; reordering via UITableView editing mode in a separate pass
rationale: toggleForumTopicIsPinned is a one-line call plus a pinned section at the top of the list; drag reordering with setPinnedForumTopics is optional polish, not required.

name: Delete a topic (all its messages)
uiSurface: Destructive action sheet item with a confirmation TGAlertView on a topic row
rationale: Single call; requires can_delete_messages, so gate the row action on the admin right.

name: Per-topic notification settings (mute/unmute)
uiSurface: Mute/Unmute item in the topic action sheet; mute icon on the row
rationale: Reuses the chatNotificationSettings dict shape we already build for chats; only mute_for and use_default_mute_for matter for a first version.

name: Mark topic read: mentions, reactions, poll votes
uiSurface: Invoked implicitly when a topic is opened, plus a Mark as read action sheet item
rationale: Three parameterless-shaped calls, no dedicated UI beyond clearing the unread badges on the row.

name: Unpin all messages in a topic
uiSurface: Action sheet item inside the topic's pinned-message banner
rationale: One call; only meaningful once the chat screen shows a pinned banner in topic mode.

name: Copy topic link
uiSurface: Copy link item in the topic action sheet, writing to UIPasteboard
rationale: Offline method, returns a string; pasteboard write is two lines.

name: Open an incoming t.me topic link
uiSurface: Link tap handler routing into the topic chat screen
rationale: Depends on the topic-mode chat screen existing and on a general internal-link router we do not have yet.

name: Topic icon rendering: colored circle fallback
uiSurface: 28pt circular icon on each topic row, drawn in code from icon.color plus the first letter of the name
rationale: Pure Core Graphics drawing from an int32 RGB value, no network or emoji rendering; this is exactly what the modern client shows when no custom emoji is set.

name: Custom-emoji topic icons
uiSurface: Emoji grid in the create/edit topic form and the real icon glyph on each row
rationale: Needs resolving custom_emoji_id to a sticker, downloading and decoding a WEBP/TGS thumbnail, and caching it per row; static WEBP thumbs are viable on a 4S (we ship UIImage+WebP) but animated TGS icons must be rendered as a still frame, and setting a non-default emoji as icon also requires Premium.

name: Convert a supergroup to a forum / toggle forum tabs
uiSurface: Topics toggle row in group admin settings
rationale: One boolean call requiring owner rights; a single switch row in the group info screen, has_forum_tabs can be passed false.

name: View chat as topics toggle
uiSurface: Switch row in chat info deciding whether the chat opens as a topic list or a flat message list
rationale: Single boolean call; our chat-open routing already branches on isForum, so it only needs to consult view_as_topics too.

name: Topic permission and rights gating
uiSurface: can_create_topics switch in group permissions, can_manage_topics switch in the admin rights editor
rationale: Two extra boolean fields in dictionaries we already send for permissions and admin rights; each is one more switch row.

name: Topic service messages in the message list
uiSurface: Centered grey service-message bubbles in the chat transcript
rationale: Four new cases in the existing service-message text formatter; no new views.

name: Forum events in the admin recent-actions log
uiSurface: Rows in an admin Recent Actions screen
rationale: There is no event-log screen in our client at all; the forum cases are cheap once that screen exists but the screen itself is new work.

name: Topic-scoped member mention suggestions
uiSurface: Autocomplete popup above the composer when typing @ inside a topic
rationale: Requires a mention autocomplete surface we do not have; the topic_id parameter is a trivial addition once it exists.

name: Topic tabs strip above the message list
uiSurface: Horizontally scrolling tab strip of topics pinned above the chat transcript
rationale: The modern tab strip is a horizontally paging collection of live chat histories; with 512MB and one A5 core keeping several topic histories resident and swipeable is not feasible, and UICollectionView does not exist on iOS 6.1 — use the plain topic list instead.

name: Main chat list loading & pagination
uiSurface: existing chat list table with infinite scroll at the bottom; TGChatListViewController
rationale: loadChats/getChats already wrapped and driving the list; only incremental paging on scroll needs adding.

name: Archived chats list
uiSurface: an 'Archived chats' row at the top of the chat list opening a second chat-list screen
rationale: TGClient already maintains archivedChats and archiveOrder; the screen is a reuse of the existing list controller.

name: Archive / unarchive a chat
uiSurface: swipe action or long-press action sheet on a chat row
rationale: setChat:archived: already exists in TGClient; only the row gesture and undo banner wiring is missing.

name: Pin / unpin chat in a list
uiSurface: long-press action sheet entry plus a pinned-background tint on the row
rationale: Wrapper exists; pinned flag comes from chatPosition.is_pinned already parsed for ordering.

name: Reorder pinned chats
uiSurface: UITableView edit mode with reorder controls limited to the pinned section
rationale: Needs an edit-mode list, drag reordering constrained to the pinned block, and a diff-to-server commit; not a single row.

name: Mark chat as unread / read
uiSurface: action-sheet entry on a chat row; renders as the blue dot badge
rationale: One-line wrapper and the badge view already exists for unread counts.

name: Mark whole list as read
uiSurface: 'Mark all as read' button in the chat list edit menu or nav action sheet
rationale: Single call taking a chat list; UI is one action-sheet button.

name: Unread counters per list (badge, muted-aware)
uiSurface: app icon badge, archive row counter, folder tab counters
rationale: Pure update handlers feeding existing label/badge views; no new layout.

name: Chat folders: list and switch between them
uiSurface: a horizontal folder tab strip under the nav bar, or a 2014-style segmented/list picker above the chat list
rationale: TGClient already fetches chats for a folder list, but the tab strip, swipe-between-folders paging and per-folder scroll state are real new UI on a 4S.

name: Chat folder create / edit / delete
uiSurface: a folder editor screen: name field, included/excluded chat pickers, contact/bot/group/channel type toggles
rationale: Full multi-section editor with two chat pickers and eight boolean type filters; substantial new UI.

name: Chat folder icon picker
uiSurface: grid of folder icons inside the folder editor
rationale: Needs an icon grid (no UICollectionView on iOS 6, must be hand-laid buttons) and a new icon asset set.

name: Reorder folders / position of main list
uiSurface: edit-mode table of folders with reorder controls
rationale: Once a folder settings list exists, this is standard UITableView reordering plus one call.

name: Recommended chat folders
uiSurface: a 'Recommended' section with Add buttons in the folder settings list
rationale: Read-only fetch rendered as table rows with an add button each.

name: Shareable folder invite links
uiSurface: invite-link sub-screen inside the folder editor with per-link chat selection
rationale: Another nested editor with chat multi-select; works server-side but is a whole screen.

name: Join a folder by invite link
uiSurface: modal confirm sheet listing the chats that would be joined, triggered by a t.me/addlist URL
rationale: Needs URL scheme handling plus a checklist confirmation modal.

name: New chats added to a shared folder
uiSurface: banner above the folder's chat list offering to add the new chats
rationale: Requires a dismissible in-list banner plus a selection sheet; low value for the port.

name: Folder tags (colored labels on rows)
uiSurface: small colored tag pills on the right of each chat row
rationale: Folder tags are a Telegram Premium feature; toggleChatFolderTags fails without an active subscription.

name: Archive settings (auto-archive unknown senders, keep unmuted archived)
uiSurface: three switch rows on an 'Archive settings' page under Privacy/Settings
rationale: Three booleans, one getter and one setter; plain UISwitch rows.

name: Chat list search (local + server + public)
uiSurface: search bar pinned above the chat list producing grouped results (chats / global / messages)
rationale: searchPublicChat exists but the multi-section combined search results view is genuinely new; searchChats/searchChatsOnServer unwrapped.

name: Recent / top chats in search
uiSurface: a 'Recent' section shown when the search field is focused but empty
rationale: Read-only chat vectors rendered with the existing chat row cell; deletions are one call each.

name: Chat positions / correct global ordering
uiSurface: no visible UI beyond correct sort order of the existing list
rationale: Order extraction already implemented for main and archive; extending it per-folder list is mechanical.

name: Public service announcement / proxy pseudo-chats in the list
uiSurface: a chat row rendered with a special subtitle and no reordering, at the very top of the list
rationale: Just a branch when reading chatPosition.source; renders with the existing cell.

name: Sponsored chats in search results
uiSurface: an ad-labelled chat row inside search results with a context menu offering report/hide
rationale: Needs a distinct row style, impression tracking on scroll, and a report options sheet; no reason to prioritise but technically possible.

name: Add chat to another list (list picker)
uiSurface: 'Add to folder' action sheet listing eligible folders
rationale: addChatToList is wrapped; getChatListsToAddChat is a one-method addition feeding an action sheet.

name: Chat list swipe actions (delete, mute, archive)
uiSurface: swipe-to-reveal buttons on a chat row
rationale: All underlying calls are wrapped, but iOS 6 has no UITableViewRowAction, so multi-button swipe must be hand-built on the cell.

name: Forum topic list as a chat list
uiSurface: topic list screen entered from a forum supergroup row
rationale: getForumTopics is wrapped but the topic list cell (icon, unread, pinned state) is a new screen.

name: Chat list previews / drafts and last-message rendering
uiSurface: the subtitle line of each chat row: red 'Draft:' prefix and 'typing…' replacement
rationale: Update handlers driving text of an existing label; matches the 2014 design exactly.

name: Send text message
uiSurface: compose bar in TGChatViewController
rationale: Fully wrapped via sendText:toChat: and already working.

name: Reply to a message
uiSurface: reply banner above compose bar plus quoted header inside the bubble in TGChatViewController
rationale: Reply-to is already wrapped and a compose banner exists; only bubble-header polish remains.

name: Reply with text quote (partial-selection quoting)
uiSurface: text-selection menu in a message bubble feeding a quote into the reply banner
rationale: Needs selectable text inside bubbles and offset/entity mapping, which our label-based bubbles do not support today.

name: Reply to a message in another chat (external reply)
uiSurface: 'Reply in another chat' entry in the message action sheet reusing TGForwardPicker
rationale: Wrapper is small but requires carrying a cross-chat reply context into the target chat controller.

name: Edit message text
uiSurface: 'Edit' row in message action sheet, compose bar switches to edit mode
rationale: editMessage:inChat:text: already exists; only the edit-mode compose banner state needs wiring.

name: Edit media caption
uiSurface: same edit-mode compose bar, entered from a photo/video bubble
rationale: One-method wrapper reusing the existing edit banner.

name: Replace media in a sent message
uiSurface: 'Replace photo' action leading to the image picker
rationale: Needs the upload pipeline re-entered for an existing message plus in-place bubble replacement.

name: Check what a message allows (edit/delete/forward permissions)
uiSurface: drives which rows appear in the long-press action sheet
rationale: Single async call whose booleans gate existing action-sheet rows; prevents showing impossible actions.

name: Delete messages for me / for everyone
uiSurface: action sheet with two destructive rows, plus the existing undo snackbar
rationale: deleteMessage:inChat: is wrapped; only the revoke flag and the two-option sheet are missing.

name: Delete all messages from one sender / by date range
uiSurface: rows in a group member's context sheet and in a chat-admin menu
rationale: Two flat calls behind confirmation alerts; only meaningful in supergroups where we are admin.

name: Clear chat history
uiSurface: row in chat profile / chat-list swipe menu
rationale: Already wrapped; needs the remove_from_chat_list and revoke toggles surfaced.

name: Forward messages
uiSurface: TGForwardPicker chat chooser
rationale: Wrapped and working with an existing picker screen.

name: Forward as copy / hide sender / remove captions
uiSurface: toggle rows on the forward-picker confirmation sheet
rationale: Same call with send_copy and remove_caption flags plus two switches on the existing picker.

name: Resend failed messages
uiSurface: tap on the red failed-send badge in a bubble, offering Resend / Delete
rationale: Requires rendering the sending-state failure affordance in bubbles, which we do not draw yet.

name: Message sending state (clock / check / double check)
uiSurface: small status glyph in the bubble timestamp row
rationale: Update handlers plus TGIcons glyphs; strongly period-correct for the 2014 design.

name: Per-chat drafts (save and restore compose text)
uiSurface: automatic on leaving a chat; draft preview shown in red in the chat-list row
rationale: Needs a debounce/flush policy on chat exit, reply-to preservation in the draft, and a new chat-list row rendering state.

name: Scheduled messages (send at date / when online)
uiSurface: long-press on Send opens a date picker; a separate scheduled-messages screen listing pending sends
rationale: Requires a date picker sheet, a second message list screen, and reschedule/send-now actions.

name: Silent send and protected content
uiSurface: toggles in the long-press-on-Send menu
rationale: Only extra fields on the options dict we already build for sendMessage.

name: Comment threads on channel posts
uiSurface: 'N comments' footer bar under channel posts opening a thread chat screen
rationale: getMessageThreadHistory is wrapped but getMessageThread is not, and a thread-scoped chat screen with its own compose bar is new plumbing.

name: Forum topics as message threads
uiSurface: TGTopicsViewController list feeding a topic-scoped chat
rationale: getForumTopics is wrapped and a topics screen exists; per-topic history and send need the topic_id plumbed through.

name: Typing / recording chat action indicator
uiSurface: navigation subtitle in the chat screen, replacing 'last seen'
rationale: Throttled outgoing call plus an update handler that swaps an existing subtitle label.

name: Mark messages read and open media content
uiSurface: invisible, driven by scroll position; plus a mentions jump button
rationale: viewMessages is wrapped; openMessageContent and the read-all calls are one-liners.

name: Copy message link (t.me permalink)
uiSurface: 'Copy Link' row in the message action sheet
rationale: Single call whose result goes to the pasteboard; getMessageLinkInfo also lets us open pasted links in-app.

name: Message reactions
uiSurface: reaction chips under the bubble plus an emoji picker strip on long-press
rationale: addMessageReaction is wrapped, but the picker strip and chip layout inside bubbles are real new UI.

name: Jump to message / jump to date
uiSurface: calendar sheet and tapping a reply header to scroll to the original
rationale: Calls exist and getChatHistory is wrapped, but anchored loading around an arbitrary message id is nontrivial in our table data source.

name: Search inside a chat
uiSurface: search bar over the chat with up/down result navigation
rationale: searchChatMessages is wrapped; the in-chat search chrome and result stepping are new UI.

name: Local unsent placeholder messages
uiSurface: none directly; used for optimistic local echo
rationale: Useful only if we want local-only entries; TDLib already gives optimistic pending messages, so low value.

name: Translate message text
uiSurface: 'Translate' row in the action sheet showing result in an alert or an expanded bubble
rationale: One call, result rendered in a TGAlertView; server-side translation needs no client work.

name: Message read date and viewer list
uiSurface: 'Seen by' row in the action sheet opening a small member list
rationale: Two calls into an existing table screen; returns an error for users who disabled read receipts, which we just hide.

name: Message view/forward statistics
uiSurface: channel post statistics screen with graphs
rationale: The payload is JSON graph data meant for a charting engine; no charting stack exists on iOS 6 here and it is admin-only for large channels.

name: Quick reply shortcut messages
uiSurface: settings screen listing shortcuts plus a '/' autocomplete in the compose bar
rationale: Needs a whole shortcut management screen and compose autocomplete; business-account feature of marginal value here.

name: Message effects on send
uiSurface: effect picker next to the send button with full-screen animation
rationale: Requires premium and full-screen animated sticker playback; the 4S cannot render those effects and non-premium accounts cannot set effect_id.

name: Inline keyboard button presses
uiSurface: tappable button rows drawn under a bot message bubble
rationale: Needs a new inline-keyboard layout under bubbles plus toast/alert handling of the answer.

name: Media album (grouped) send
uiSurface: multi-select image picker and a grid layout inside one bubble
rationale: Album grid geometry inside a bubble plus multi-upload progress is substantial layout work, though memory-wise feasible with downscaled thumbs.

name: Auto-delete timer for a chat
uiSurface: picker row in the chat profile
rationale: Already wrapped; just needs a value picker sheet.

name: Report messages
uiSurface: multi-step action sheet driven by the returned option list
rationale: The result type is a state machine of option lists and free text, so it needs a small driven flow rather than one sheet.

name: Embed code for a public message
uiSurface: 'Copy embed code' row
rationale: One call to the pasteboard; niche but free.

name: Sponsored message view metrics
uiSurface: none user-facing
rationale: Only meaningful for sponsored-ad rendering we do not and should not implement.

name: Contact list (fetch + display)
uiSurface: table view of contacts with avatar + last-seen subtitle; the Contacts tab
rationale: getContacts is already wrapped and returns user ids; rendering is a plain grouped table row.

name: Contact search
uiSurface: UISearchBar above the contacts table
rationale: One-line wrapper returning Users; feeds the same cell as the contact list.

name: Add contact (manual entry)
uiSurface: modal form with first/last name + phone fields, plus 'share my phone number' toggle; from Contacts tab + button and from a user profile
rationale: Needs a new small form screen and validation, not just a row.

name: Remove contact / delete contact
uiSurface: destructive row on user profile and swipe-to-delete in contacts list
rationale: Single call with a user id array plus a confirmation action sheet.

name: Address Book import and sync
uiSurface: one-time permission prompt on first Contacts tab open + a 'Sync contacts' toggle and 'Delete synced contacts' row in Privacy settings
rationale: importContacts is wrapped, but the AddressBook.framework read on iOS 6 (ABAddressBookCreate, no ABAddressBookCreateWithOptions completion-based auth path pre-iOS6? it exists in 6.0), phone normalisation and diffing against changeImportedContacts is real client plumbing.

name: Find user by phone number
uiSurface: search field result section 'not in your contacts'
rationale: Already wrapped; just surface the returned user as a row.

name: Find user by username / t.me deep token
uiSurface: global search results section
rationale: searchUserByToken is a one-method wrap used only for temporary contact links; the search UI already exists.

name: Temporary contact link (add-me QR/link)
uiSurface: 'Add People Nearby'-style share sheet showing a t.me link and expiry; row in Contacts tab
rationale: Needs a new share screen with countdown; QR rendering already exists in this project but the link screen is new.

name: Share my phone number with a user
uiSurface: banner/button in a private chat when need_phone_number_privacy_exception is set
rationale: One call plus a chat-header banner, which the project already has a compose-banner pattern for.

name: Close friends list
uiSurface: multi-select contact picker screen reached from Privacy settings; star badge on profile
rationale: Two trivial calls but needs a checkbox multi-select picker screen that does not exist yet; only meaningful alongside stories.

name: User profile: core fields display
uiSurface: profile screen header + info rows (phone, username, bio)
rationale: Both getters already wrapped; remaining work is laying out rows on the existing profile screen.

name: Own profile editing: name, bio, username
uiSurface: Edit Profile screen with text fields and a bio character counter
rationale: All three setters are already wrapped; simple text-field rows.

name: Multiple usernames (active/inactive, reorder)
uiSurface: list of usernames with toggle switches and drag reorder in Edit Profile
rationale: Needs an editable reorderable table (UITableView editing mode works on iOS 6) plus two new wrappers; more than a single row.

name: Profile photo: set / delete / view history
uiSurface: action sheet on avatar tap (Take Photo / Choose from Library / Delete) and a paged photo viewer
rationale: UIImagePickerController plus mandatory downscale before upload on a 512MB 4S; photo history browsing is new UI.

name: Animated / video profile photo
uiSurface: video picker in the avatar action sheet
rationale: The 4S has no practical H.264 encode path for a trimmed looping avatar under iOS 6 and cannot play the animated avatar back inline; static photos only.

name: Personal photo set for another contact
uiSurface: 'Set Photo for <name>' / 'Suggest Photo' rows in the contact's profile action sheet
rationale: Two easy calls but reuses the same picker+downscale plumbing as own avatar, so it lands after that.

name: Birthdate: set own, display, privacy
uiSurface: date picker row in Edit Profile plus a birthday row on profiles; privacy row in Privacy settings
rationale: setBirthdate is one wrapper; UIDatePicker exists on iOS 6 and the privacy setting getter/setter are already wrapped.

name: Contact birthdays today (close birthdays)
uiSurface: a dismissible section at the top of the Contacts tab listing users with birthdays
rationale: Comes free as an update; UI is one extra table section plus a dismiss call.

name: Suggest a birthdate to a contact / birthdate suggestion message
uiSurface: profile action row, and an in-chat service-message bubble with an Accept button
rationale: Requires a new message-content renderer with an inline action button in the chat list of bubbles.

name: Personal channel on profile
uiSurface: picker of own channels in Edit Profile; a channel preview cell with its latest post on the viewed profile
rationale: The picker is trivial, but rendering the linked channel's most recent post inside the profile screen is genuinely new layout.

name: Private note about a contact
uiSurface: editable multiline note row on the contact's profile
rationale: One setter taking formattedText; a UITextView sheet is enough.

name: Groups in common with a user
uiSurface: 'N groups in common' row on the profile opening a chat list
rationale: Single paginated call reusing the existing chat-list cell.

name: Block / unblock user, blocked users list
uiSurface: Block row on profile + Blocked Users screen in Privacy settings
rationale: Both calls already wrapped; UI is rows and swipe-to-unblock.

name: Last-seen and online status
uiSurface: subtitle string in chat header, contact rows and profile
rationale: Pure formatting of an update payload into a localized 'last seen' string; no new screens.

name: Privacy settings for profile data
uiSurface: Privacy settings list with a per-setting Everybody/Contacts/Nobody radio screen plus exception pickers
rationale: Getter/setter wrapped, but the exception lists (allow/restrict specific users) need a multi-select user picker screen.

name: Emoji status on own and others' profiles
uiSurface: custom-emoji picker next to the name
rationale: Custom emoji statuses are animated TGS/webm premium assets; no Lottie/webm decode on a 4S under iOS 6, and setting one requires Premium.

name: Profile accent colors and background custom emoji
uiSurface: color-swatch grid in Edit Profile
rationale: Requires Premium to set, the swatch grid wants UICollectionView which is unavailable pre-iOS 6 here, and the design brief targets the flat 2013 look which has no per-user accent colors.

name: Profile audio (profile song)
uiSurface: audio row with play button on the profile header
rationale: Premium-gated modern feature with no counterpart in the 2013 design; not worth the streaming plumbing.

name: Main profile tab selection (Posts/Gifts/Media...)
uiSurface: segmented tab strip on the profile screen
rationale: Only meaningful once the profile has a real paged media/gift section; the tab strip and paging is substantial new layout.

name: Support user / support name
uiSurface: 'Ask a Question' row in Settings opening a private chat
rationale: One call then createPrivateChat, which is already wrapped.

name: Sponsored-messages opt-out on own profile
uiSurface: toggle row in Privacy settings
rationale: Disabling sponsored messages requires an active Premium subscription server-side; the toggle would always fail.

name: Contact registered notification
uiSurface: service-message bubble '<name> joined Telegram'
rationale: One extra case in the existing service-message text renderer.

name: Share contact as a message / contact card
uiSurface: 'Share Contact' in attachment menu; contact bubble with avatar, name and Add/Call actions
rationale: Needs a contact picker in the attachment sheet and a new message-bubble layout with vCard handling.

name: Create new basic group
uiSurface: contact multi-select + title entry, two-step 'New Group' flow reached from the chats list compose button
rationale: Needs a real member-picker screen with selection state and a title/photo header, which we do not have yet.

name: Create new supergroup / channel
uiSurface: same New Group flow with a type step (group vs channel) plus optional description field
rationale: Shares the picker UI with basic groups but adds a type/description step and public-username follow-up.

name: Upgrade basic group to supergroup
uiSurface: single destructive-styled row in group info ('Convert to Supergroup') with confirm action sheet; chat id changes so the open chat must be reopened
rationale: One request plus an action sheet; the service messages for it are already rendered by TGClient.

name: Group info: title, photo, description editing
uiSurface: editable header on the existing chat profile screen: text field for title, tap-avatar photo picker, multiline description cell
rationale: Requires an edit mode on the profile screen and an image pick/upload path (downscale before upload on a 4S).

name: Group full info fetch (basic and supergroup)
uiSurface: data source for the chat profile screen header and counters
rationale: TGClient already issues getBasicGroupFullInfo/getSupergroup/getSupergroupFullInfo via chatProfile:; only extra fields need surfacing.

name: Member list with paging and filters
uiSurface: members table section on the chat profile screen, with a segmented/filtered list screen for the admin views
rationale: membersOfChat: already wraps getSupergroupMembers with supergroupMembersFilterRecent; other filters are a parameter change plus offset paging.

name: Search members inside a group
uiSurface: search bar above the members list on the members screen
rationale: One wrapper method feeding the same member cell we already render.

name: Add members to a group
uiSurface: 'Add Members' row on group profile opening the contact picker; failure list shown as an alert
rationale: Needs the same reusable contact multi-select picker as group creation, plus handling of the failedToAddMembers privacy result.

name: Remove member / kick
uiSurface: swipe-to-delete or long-press action sheet on a member row
rationale: Single call with chatMemberStatusLeft on an existing row.

name: Ban member and revoke their messages
uiSurface: action sheet on a member row: Remove / Ban / Ban and delete all messages
rationale: Two straightforward calls behind an action sheet.

name: Banned users list and unban
uiSurface: 'Removed Users' list screen reached from group admin settings; swipe to unban
rationale: Reuses the member list screen with a different filter and one unban call.

name: Restrict member (per-user permissions, timed)
uiSurface: per-user restrictions screen: toggle rows per permission plus a duration picker
rationale: A whole new form screen with ~10 toggles and a until-date picker; permission interdependencies need real layout work.

name: Promote member to administrator with rights
uiSurface: admin rights screen: toggle rows for each right, custom title field, 'Dismiss admin' destructive row
rationale: New multi-toggle form; must also read can_be_edited and hide rights that do not apply to basic groups.

name: Administrators list
uiSurface: 'Administrators' row in group settings opening a list with creator/admin subtitles
rationale: One call returning a flat array rendered with the existing member cell.

name: Default group permissions
uiSurface: 'Permissions' screen with a toggle per right, shown for groups where we are admin
rationale: New form screen; the modern permission set is much larger than 2013 Telegram had, so the row set needs a design decision.

name: Transfer group ownership
uiSurface: 'Transfer Ownership' row plus a 2FA password prompt alert
rationale: Requires a password entry sheet and TDLib 2FA/recent-login preconditions we currently have no UI for.

name: Public group username
uiSurface: 'Group Type' screen: Private/Public selector, username field with live availability check, invite link display
rationale: Needs a dedicated screen with debounced validation feedback and the too-many-public-chats recovery list.

name: Primary invite link and revoke
uiSurface: invite link cell in group info with Copy / Share / Revoke action sheet
rationale: Link already arrives in basicGroupFullInfo/supergroupFullInfo; only the revoke call is new.

name: Additional invite links management
uiSurface: 'Invite Links' list screen with a create form (name, expiry, member limit, request-approval switch)
rationale: A whole sub-module: list, creation form with date/limit pickers, and per-link joined-members screen.

name: Join group by invite link
uiSurface: preview alert with group title/photo/member count and a Join button, triggered by a t.me/joinchat URL
rationale: joinChat is already wrapped via setChat:joined:; link handling adds one check call and a confirm alert.

name: Join requests approval
uiSurface: 'Join Requests' badge row on group info opening a list with Approve/Dismiss buttons per row
rationale: Needs a new list screen with per-row two-button cells and a live pending counter.

name: Leave and delete group
uiSurface: destructive rows at the bottom of group info with confirm action sheet
rationale: leaveChat and deleteChatHistory are wrapped; deleteChat needs one small method.

name: Slow mode
uiSurface: row in group admin settings with a value picker (off/10s/30s/1m/5m/15m/1h)
rationale: One call driven by an action sheet of fixed values.

name: Chat history visibility for new members
uiSurface: two-option row (Visible / Hidden) in group settings
rationale: Single boolean toggle.

name: Hide member list
uiSurface: switch row in group settings, gated on can_hide_members
rationale: Single boolean toggle.

name: Aggressive anti-spam
uiSurface: switch row in group settings plus a 'Report Spam' item in the message action sheet
rationale: Two simple calls; only available for groups above a member threshold, so gate on can_toggle_aggressive_anti_spam.

name: Restrict saving content
uiSurface: switch row in group settings
rationale: Single boolean toggle.

name: Group sticker set
uiSurface: row showing current set, opening a sticker-set search/pick screen
rationale: Requires a sticker set search and preview screen we do not have.

name: Linked discussion group for channels
uiSurface: 'Discussion' row in channel settings opening a chooser list of suitable groups
rationale: One list call and one setter, rendered with the existing chat cell.

name: Location-based groups
uiSurface: map picker plus address field in group settings
rationale: Needs a map picker and nearby-chat discovery; MapKit on iOS 6 uses the withdrawn Apple Maps tile service and the nearby-chats server surface is effectively dead.

name: Recent actions / admin event log
uiSurface: 'Recent Actions' screen rendering each event as a message-like row, with a filter sheet
rationale: Rendering ~50 distinct ChatEventAction variants into readable rows is substantial new presentation code.

name: Group signature and sender display
uiSurface: switch row in channel settings
rationale: Single boolean toggle, channel-only.

name: Join to send / join by request gating
uiSurface: two switch rows in group type settings
rationale: Two boolean toggles.

name: Report group
uiSurface: 'Report' row opening an action sheet of server-provided options, then optional text entry
rationale: The modern report flow is a server-driven multi-step option tree, not a fixed reason list, so it needs a small state machine screen.

name: Convert supergroup to broadcast group / gigagroup
uiSurface: destructive one-way row in group settings with confirm alert
rationale: Single irreversible call behind a confirmation.

name: Forum topics mode for groups
uiSurface: switch row plus a topic-list chat variant
rationale: getForumTopics is already wrapped for reading, but enabling and managing topics needs a whole alternate chat-list presentation.

name: Group boosts and boost level requirements
uiSurface: boost status screen with level progress
rationale: Boosting requires an active Telegram Premium subscription on the account and premium-gated server flows we cannot exercise from this client.

name: Paid messages in groups
uiSurface: star-count row in group settings
rationale: Depends on the Telegram Stars balance/payment stack, which needs in-app purchase plumbing unavailable on this legacy build.

name: Group statistics
uiSurface: charts screen
rationale: Statistics are delivered as JSON graph specs meant for a JS/web chart renderer; no WKWebView on iOS 6 and no charting stack, so this is out of reach for a reasonable effort.

name: Group video chats
uiSurface: call bar and participant list on the group screen
rationale: Multi-party WebRTC audio mixing on a single-core A5 with 512MB is not viable, and the group-call protocol is far beyond the 1:1 call path we already have.

name: Recent stickers strip
uiSurface: horizontal scroll row of sticker thumbnails at the top of the sticker keyboard panel above the chat input
rationale: TGClient already has recentStickersWithCompletion:; the remaining add/remove/clear are one-line wrappers over an existing send-request path and the UI is a UIScrollView of image buttons.

name: Send a sticker to a chat
uiSurface: tap on any sticker cell in the sticker panel; rendered in the message list as a transparent bubble-less image
rationale: sendStickerWithFileId:toChat:thread: exists and messageSticker is already parsed in the message mapper.

name: Installed sticker sets list
uiSurface: grouped UITableView of sets with cover thumbnail, title and sticker count — a new 'Stickers' screen under Settings
rationale: One request returning a flat vector of stickerSetInfo; the screen is a standard 2013-style grouped table with a thumbnail and two labels per row.

name: Install / uninstall / archive a sticker set
uiSurface: Add/Remove button in the set preview screen plus swipe-to-delete on the installed-sets table row
rationale: Single function with two Bool flags; UI is a button and a table row delete.

name: Reorder installed sticker sets
uiSurface: UITableView editing mode with reorder controls on the Stickers settings screen
rationale: UITableView setEditing plus moveRowAtIndexPath is fully available on iOS 6; the call takes an ordered id vector.

name: Archived sticker sets
uiSurface: 'Archived Stickers' table pushed from the Stickers settings screen, each row restorable
rationale: Same table shape as installed sets, paginated by offset_sticker_set_id.

name: Trending / featured sticker sets with unread badge
uiSurface: 'Trending' tab inside the sticker panel and a badged row in Stickers settings; each entry shows up to 5 cover stickers and an Add button
rationale: Needs a new cell type laying out a horizontal cover strip plus an inline Add button, badge bookkeeping and view-marking on scroll — real layout work, not a table row.

name: Sticker set preview / open by name from t.me link
uiSurface: modal sheet-style set preview: grid of all stickers in the set with title bar and a full-width Add Stickers button at the bottom
rationale: No UICollectionView on iOS 6, so the sticker grid must be hand-laid out in a UIScrollView with tiled recycled image views; also needs deep-link routing.

name: Sticker keyboard panel (set tab bar + grid)
uiSurface: input-accessory panel replacing the keyboard, with a bottom tab strip of set covers and a paged/scrolling sticker grid — the central new UI of this area
rationale: The single biggest surface here: custom grid layout without UICollectionView, thumbnail cache, memory-bounded recycling on a 512MB device, and swap logic with the text keyboard.

name: Favourite stickers
uiSurface: a starred first tab in the sticker panel plus 'Add to Favorites' in the long-press action sheet on a sticker
rationale: Three trivial calls; UI is one extra tab reusing the grid and a UIActionSheet item.

name: Search stickers by emoji / query
uiSurface: search field at the top of the sticker panel; results fill the same grid
rationale: Call itself is simple but it needs the grid surface plus debounced paging, so it lands with the panel rather than standalone.

name: Search sticker sets (installed and global)
uiSurface: UISearchBar over the Stickers settings table, results as the same set rows
rationale: Standard UISearchDisplayController pattern over an existing row type.

name: Emoji suggestion by typed keyword (:smile)
uiSurface: a thin horizontal suggestion bar above the chat input, same shape as the existing mention/hashtag suggestion strip
rationale: Returns plain emoji strings which iOS 6 renders natively via Apple Color Emoji; wrapper is one method and the strip is a scroll view of buttons.

name: Sticker suggestion for a lone typed emoji
uiSurface: popup strip of matching stickers above the input when the composed text is a single emoji
rationale: Needs a new floating panel above the input plus text-watching logic to detect the single-emoji state.

name: Emoji categories / greeting stickers
uiSurface: category icon row inside the emoji keyboard; greeting stickers shown in an empty chat
rationale: Category icons are themselves stickers (often animated), so the row needs the sticker renderer; also drives a new empty-chat state.

name: Emoji keyboard with recent/sections
uiSurface: tabbed emoji picker panel (Recent, Smileys, Animals, ...) sharing the same input-accessory container as the sticker panel
rationale: Classic 2013 Telegram emoji keyboard; needs hand-rolled paged grid and a locally persisted recents list, no UICollectionView available.

name: Animated (.tgs) sticker playback
uiSurface: in-bubble playing sticker in the message list and in the sticker grid
rationale: TGLottieView already exists and TGClient reports stickerFormatTgs, but CPU-bound Lottie rendering on a single-core A5 needs strict policy: play at most one at a time, static first frame elsewhere, downscaled raster cache.

name: Static WEBP sticker rendering
uiSurface: sticker image in bubbles, grids and set covers
rationale: UIImage+WebP decoder is already in the project and TGClient already surfaces stickerFormatWebp; only a downscaled thumbnail cache is needed.

name: Video (WEBM/VP9) stickers
uiSurface: would be an animated cell in bubbles and the sticker grid
rationale: iOS 6 AVFoundation cannot decode VP9-in-WEBM and the A5 has no hardware path for it; only the static WEBP/PNG thumbnail can be shown, so treat animation as unavailable and fall back to the thumbnail.

name: Custom emoji in message text
uiSurface: inline images substituted into message text in the chat bubble and in chat-list previews
rationale: Sending requires Premium, but rendering incoming ones does not; needs inline-attachment text layout in our custom bubble drawing, which on iOS 6 (no TextKit) means manual glyph-run measurement — substantial but doable, and a plain-emoji fallback is acceptable.

name: Custom emoji sticker sets picker (send custom emoji)
uiSurface: a third tab in the emoji panel listing custom-emoji sets
rationale: Sending custom emoji requires an active Telegram Premium subscription; without it the server rejects the message, so only read-side rendering is worth building.

name: Emoji status on own profile / other users
uiSurface: small badge beside the name in profile and chat list; a picker sheet in Settings
rationale: Setting an emoji status is Premium-only; displaying someone else's status is just a custom-emoji glyph and folds into the custom-emoji rendering feature rather than standing alone.

name: Sticker long-press preview
uiSurface: enlarged floating sticker overlay while the finger is held down, with 'view pack' and favourite actions on release
rationale: Requires a long-press gesture on the grid plus an overlay window and hit-tracking as the finger moves between cells.

name: Attached sticker sets on a photo/video
uiSurface: a 'Stickers' button in the media viewer that opens a set list sheet
rationale: One call keyed by file id; result reuses the set-row table.

name: Sticker set as group sticker pack
uiSurface: a row in group admin settings opening a set-name entry field
rationale: A text field plus searchStickerSet validation and one setter; admin-only but structurally a settings row.

name: Animated emoji in message (single-emoji big animation)
uiSurface: oversized animated emoji instead of a text bubble when the message is one emoji; tap triggers the click animation
rationale: TGClient already parses messageAnimatedEmoji, but the sticker is TGS so it needs the same one-at-a-time Lottie playback policy and a bubble-less message cell variant.

name: Create / edit own sticker sets
uiSurface: a full sticker-authoring flow: image picker, per-sticker emoji assignment, reorderable list
rationale: Real users do this through @stickers bot, and the flow needs image processing plus a multi-screen editor that is far out of proportion to its value on a 4S; deliberately out of scope.

name: Sticker outline placeholder
uiSurface: grey vector silhouette drawn while a sticker file downloads
rationale: Nice-looking loading state but needs closed-vector-path drawing into CoreGraphics from the outline paths; optional polish, a plain grey rounded rect is the cheap fallback.

name: Emoji suggestions URL (animated emoji suggestion data)
uiSurface: none — would be consumed by an in-app web view
rationale: The returned URL is meant to be opened in a modern web view; iOS 6 has only UIWebView and the page relies on current JS, so it cannot be usefully rendered.

name: Mask stickers
uiSurface: face-mask placement UI in a photo editor
rationale: Requires a photo editor with face detection and interactive mask placement; no such editor exists in our client and it is not worth building for a 4S.

name: Premium stickers and premium sticker examples
uiSurface: premium promo screens and the extra unlock animation on premium stickers
rationale: Requires an active Premium subscription for the effect to play, and the promo surfaces are pure upsell UI we have no reason to port.

name: Rich text entities (bold/italic/code/pre/links/mentions)
uiSurface: attributed-string rendering inside the chat bubble label (TGChatViewController/ChatViewCell) plus tap regions
rationale: TGClient flattens messageText to a plain string today; entity-aware layout on iOS 6 needs a custom CoreText/attributed-run text view with hit testing since UILabel there has no attributedText.

name: Spoiler and expandable blockquote entities
uiSurface: masked/blurred text run that reveals on tap, and an indented quote block in the bubble
rationale: Requires the entity text engine above plus a per-run overlay layer and expand/collapse re-layout.

name: Custom emoji entity
uiSurface: inline animated sticker glyph inside text runs
rationale: Inline TGS/WEBM animated glyphs at text scale would need per-run animated layers on a single-core A5; also premium-gated for sending.

name: Markdown parse on send / entity extraction
uiSurface: none — invisible transform applied to composer text before sendMessage
rationale: Single synchronous-style TDLib call added next to the existing inputMessageText path in TGClient.

name: Photo message send and view
uiSurface: bubble thumbnail in chat plus a full-screen viewer
rationale: TGClient already wraps inputMessagePhoto and downloadFile and the chat cell already renders photo thumbs; remaining work is incremental.

name: Photo/video caption with entities and edit caption
uiSurface: caption line under media in the bubble; an edit sheet reusing the composer
rationale: editMessageCaption mirrors the already-wrapped editMessageText; caption display is a second label in an existing cell.

name: Media spoiler (has_spoiler) send/reveal
uiSurface: blurred cover over the media thumb, tap to reveal; a toggle in the attach sheet
rationale: Needs a real blur/dot-pattern cover layer generated on-device — no UIVisualEffectView on iOS 6 — plus a new attach-sheet control.

name: Self-destructing photo/video (view-once)
uiSurface: timer picker in attach sheet; countdown overlay in viewer; expired placeholder bubble
rationale: New viewer state machine plus openMessageContent plumbing and expired-content bubbles.

name: Video message send and playback
uiSurface: thumbnail with play badge and duration in bubble; MPMoviePlayerViewController for playback
rationale: inputMessageVideo already wrapped; playback uses the iOS 6 MPMoviePlayer, no AVPlayerViewController.

name: Video streaming / alternative qualities / storyboards
uiSurface: progressive playback and a scrub preview strip
rationale: Streaming from a partially downloaded TDLib file needs a local HTTP/HLS shim and seek logic well beyond what a 512MB 4S build can carry; storyboards are pure decoration on top of that.

name: GIF / animation messages
uiSurface: auto-looping thumbnail in bubble with GIF badge; saved-GIFs picker in attach sheet
rationale: Flatten path exists but real playback needs MP4 loop decoding on A5; currently only a static thumbnail is feasible without new plumbing.

name: Music/audio file messages
uiSurface: track row in bubble (cover, title, performer, duration) with play/pause; ties into the existing voice player
rationale: Needs a new bubble layout plus a shared audio playback controller; the existing voice-note player is single-clip only.

name: Voice note record, send, play
uiSurface: hold-to-record button and waveform bubble with play control
rationale: Fully wrapped (inputVoiceNote) and TGVoiceRecorder/TGVoiceDecoder already exist; only listened-state via openMessageContent is missing.

name: Voice/video note speech recognition transcript
uiSurface: transcript expand button on the voice bubble
rationale: Server-side transcription is Telegram Premium only; without a subscription the call errors.

name: Round video note playback
uiSurface: circular video bubble with tap-to-play
rationale: Flatten path and circular video note UI already landed in a prior commit.

name: Round video note recording
uiSurface: front-camera capture overlay in the composer
rationale: Needs live square-cropped H.264 capture and mux on a 4S with no hardware pipeline exposed through iOS 6 AVFoundation at usable quality.

name: Generic document / file messages
uiSurface: file row in bubble with icon, name, size, download ring; QLPreviewController or share sheet on tap
rationale: Rendering exists in flatten but sending, progress rings and preview are new plumbing; no document picker on iOS 6 so the source list must be custom.

name: Static sticker send and display
uiSurface: borderless sticker in bubble; sticker keyboard panel
rationale: inputMessageSticker and getRecentStickers are wrapped and WebP decoding exists via UIImage+WebP.

name: Animated (TGS) and video (WEBM) stickers
uiSurface: animated sticker in bubble, loops on tap
rationale: TGLottieView exists so TGS is reachable at reduced frame rate, but WEBM/VP9 has no decoder on iOS 6 and needs a first-frame fallback.

name: Animated emoji messages and tap effect
uiSurface: large emoji sticker in bubble, tap triggers effect
rationale: Flatten already maps it to a sticker, but the tap-effect round trip and full-screen effect animation are new.

name: Static location message send and map view
uiSurface: map thumbnail bubble; MKMapView detail screen with directions action
rationale: inputMessageLocation wrapped and a location bubble exists; getMapThumbnailFile is a one-method addition.

name: Live location sharing
uiSurface: duration picker sheet, live bubble with countdown, stop-sharing bar
rationale: Requires background CLLocationManager updates plus periodic editMessageLiveLocation and expiry handling; heavy battery/plumbing work but possible on iOS 6.

name: Venue message send and display
uiSurface: venue bubble (title, address, pin) and a nearby-venue picker in the attach sheet
rationale: Display already flattens, but the picker needs a venue search source TDLib does not provide directly (getInlineQueryResults via a places bot) — real new plumbing.

name: Contact message send and display
uiSurface: contact bubble with avatar and name; tap opens profile or add-contact
rationale: inputMessageContact wrapped, flatten handles messageContact, and an address-book picker screen already exists.

name: Poll voting and results display
uiSurface: interactive poll bubble with option rows and result bars
rationale: setPollAnswer is wrapped as votePoll and the interactive poll bubble shipped in a recent commit.

name: Poll creation and stopping
uiSurface: poll composer screen (question, option rows, anonymous/multiple/quiz toggles); stop action in message menu
rationale: A whole new multi-field editor screen; stopPoll alone would be trivial but creation dominates.

name: Poll voter list
uiSurface: per-option voter list pushed from the poll bubble
rationale: One wrapper plus a plain user-row table reusing the contacts cell.

name: Dice / slot machine messages
uiSurface: animated dice sticker in bubble; emoji entries in the attach or emoji panel
rationale: Flatten handles messageDice as text today; real dice needs TGS playback of initial/final states and slot-machine multi-part composition.

name: Game messages
uiSurface: game preview bubble with Play button opening a web view
rationale: HTML5 games need a modern web runtime; iOS 6 UIWebView cannot run current Telegram game bundles and there is no WKWebView.

name: Invoice / payment messages
uiSurface: invoice bubble with product photo, price and Pay button; checkout flow
rationale: Checkout requires a provider web flow and card entry through a modern web view; not viable on iOS 6, and star payments are account-gated.

name: Story shared into a chat
uiSurface: story preview bubble; full-screen story viewer
rationale: Photo stories are viewable with a new full-screen viewer; the story fetch plus expiry/unavailable states are substantial plumbing (video stories degrade to a thumbnail).

name: Paid media messages
uiSurface: blurred preview with star-price unlock button
rationale: Unlocking requires a Telegram Stars balance and purchase flow we cannot reach on this client.

name: Link preview (web page) attached to text
uiSurface: vertical accent bar block under the text with site name, title, description and optional image
rationale: New sub-layout inside the text bubble plus link_preview_options plumbing on send (disable/above-text).

name: Instant View article reader
uiSurface: full-screen article reader
rationale: Rendering the IV block tree is a large custom renderer and the practical shortcut (a web view) is unusable on iOS 6 for modern pages.

name: Expired media placeholders
uiSurface: italic service-style bubble text
rationale: Four extra branches in TGFlattenMessage returning a localized string.

name: Unsupported content placeholder
uiSurface: grey bubble text telling the user to view on another device
rationale: One fallback branch in the flatten switch, which currently produces a derived type name.

name: Media album grouping
uiSurface: grid of photos in one bubble; multi-select in the attach sheet
rationale: Needs a grouping pass over history plus a mosaic layout engine and multi-pick UI.

name: Media timestamp links in captions
uiSurface: tappable timestamp in text that seeks the referenced audio/video
rationale: Once the entity engine exists this is a tap handler that seeks the existing player; small on its own.

name: Save incoming media to camera roll / share
uiSurface: action sheet entry on long-press of a media message
rationale: downloadFile is wrapped; saving is ALAssetsLibrary plus an entry in the existing TGActionSheet.

name: Message translation
uiSurface: Translate row in the message action sheet, result shown under the bubble
rationale: One wrapper and one extra label line; the server does the work.

name: Copy media link / message link
uiSurface: Copy Link row in the message action sheet
rationale: Single call feeding UIPasteboard from the existing action sheet.

name: Channel signatures toggle
uiSurface: Two UISwitch rows ("Sign Messages", "Show Author Profiles") in channel admin/edit screen
rationale: Single boolean call, supergroup already fetched by TGClient getSupergroup; author_signature is already present on every message for rendering.

name: Render author signature on channel posts
uiSurface: Small grey name label in the message bubble footer next to the timestamp, chat view
rationale: Field arrives on every message already; purely a bubble layout addition.

name: Discussion group linking
uiSurface: "Discussion" row in channel admin screen opening a picker list of suitable groups, plus an unlink confirmation action sheet
rationale: getSuitableDiscussionChats returns a plain chat list; picker is a UITableView and the setter is one call.

name: Comments button on channel posts (open discussion thread)
uiSurface: "N Comments" footer button under channel posts that pushes a thread chat view
rationale: getMessageThreadHistory is wrapped but a real comments thread screen with its own composer, reply-to-post header and unread counter is substantial new UI plumbing.

name: Channel statistics overview (numbers only)
uiSurface: "Statistics" row in channel profile pushing a grouped table of statisticalValue pairs (followers, mean views, shares, notification %)
rationale: The scalar half of chatStatisticsChannel maps directly to value+growth-percentage table cells; no charting needed.

name: Channel statistics graphs
uiSurface: Line/bar chart cards inside the statistics screen, with zoom-token drilldown
rationale: Graphs arrive as raw JSON series that must be parsed and drawn in Core Graphics by hand — no charting library, no WKWebView on iOS 6 — so this needs a custom chart view designed from scratch.

name: Supergroup statistics (discussion group side)
uiSurface: Same statistics screen in supergroup variant: top senders / top admins / top inviters member rows
rationale: Different response class but the top-N lists are ordinary avatar+name+subtitle rows once the statistics screen exists.

name: Per-post statistics
uiSurface: "View Statistics" item in the message long-press action sheet, pushing a per-message stats screen
rationale: The scalar view count is trivial, but the payload is entirely graphs plus a public-forwards list, so it needs the chart view and a forwards list screen.

name: Post view counter on channel messages
uiSurface: Eye glyph + count in the bubble footer of channel posts, chat view
rationale: Data already flows via message updates; viewMessages is wrapped, only bubble footer drawing is missing.

name: Boost status and boost this channel
uiSurface: "Boost" row / level progress bar sheet in channel profile, with a boost confirm alert and share-link action
rationale: Boosting itself is one call, but the level-progress bar, slot picker and the level-features explainer are genuinely new visual components; the share-link fallback keeps it usable for non-premium users.

name: Boosters list
uiSurface: Paginated member-style list of boosters with expiry subtitle, pushed from the boost screen; admin only
rationale: Plain paginated avatar+name+date rows, standard table view.

name: Boost level features explainer
uiSurface: Static per-level feature checklist inside the boost sheet
rationale: Pure data-to-rows rendering, no interaction.

name: Boost deep link handling
uiSurface: URL handler that resolves a t.me boost link and opens the boost sheet
rationale: One resolve call feeding into whatever boost screen exists.

name: Boost-gated channel appearance (accent color, emoji status, custom background)
uiSurface: Appearance section in channel admin screen with color swatch grid
rationale: Animated custom emoji statuses and custom emoji backgrounds cannot render on a 4S/iOS 6 (no TGS/lottie playback path, memory-prohibitive), and these settings are meaningless without the rendering; flat accent color alone could be revisited later.

name: Star subscription invite links (paid channel subscriptions)
uiSurface: "Subscription link" creation form (price + name) in the channel invite-links screen
rationale: Creating them requires the channel owner to be eligible server side, and joining requires an in-app Stars purchase flow (StoreKit product for Stars) that does not exist for this client on iOS 6.

name: My channel subscriptions (Stars) management
uiSurface: "Subscriptions" list in Settings with a cancel action sheet per row
rationale: Listing and cancelling need no purchase flow and are honest to support, but need a new settings sub-screen; renewal still ends up blocked at top-up.

name: Subscription-expiry member state
uiSurface: Expiry subtitle in member rows and an "expired subscribers" filter in the link members list
rationale: Extra field on rows already rendered by the members list.

name: Channel invite link management
uiSurface: "Invite Links" screen: primary link cell with copy/share, list of additional links, per-link action sheet, creation form with expiry/usage limit
rationale: Several screens and a creation form with date and count pickers; not a single row, though every underlying call is trivial to wrap.

name: Join requests approval queue
uiSurface: Toggle in admin screen, a chat-header pending-requests bar, and a requests list with Approve/Dismiss buttons per row
rationale: List rows with two buttons plus one toggle; chat.pending_join_requests already arrives on the chat object.

name: Channel public username / private link switch
uiSurface: "Channel Type" screen: Public/Private segmented choice, username text field with live availability check, link preview
rationale: Needs a dedicated screen with debounced availability checking and error states, plus handling the too-many-public-chats case.

name: Channel history visibility for new subscribers
uiSurface: Toggle row in the discussion group's admin screen
rationale: Single boolean call. Applies to the linked discussion supergroup.

name: Slow mode for discussion group
uiSurface: Slow-mode value picker row (off/10s/30s/1m/5m/15m/1h) in group admin, plus a countdown label above the composer
rationale: Discrete option list in a table plus a timer label; no custom slider needed on this hardware.

name: Boost-based slow mode exemption
uiSurface: Stepper/option row under slow mode in group admin
rationale: One integer setter next to the slow mode row.

name: Channel admin list and permissions
uiSurface: "Administrators" list plus a per-admin rights screen of toggles and a custom-title field
rationale: getSupergroupMembers is already wrapped and the rights editor is a screen of plain switches; only setChatMemberStatus needs wrapping.

name: Channel subscriber removal / ban list
uiSurface: "Removed Users" list with swipe-to-unban in the channel admin screen
rationale: Same member list machinery with a different filter constant.

name: Hidden members in discussion group
uiSurface: Toggle row in group admin
rationale: One boolean, gated by can_hide_members.

name: Aggressive anti-spam for discussion group
uiSurface: Toggle row plus a "Report false positive" item in the message action sheet
rationale: Boolean toggle and one action-sheet entry.

name: Report spam in supergroup
uiSurface: "Report Spam" item in the message long-press action sheet for admins
rationale: One call with the selected message ids.

name: Convert channel to broadcast group / gigagroup
uiSurface: Destructive row plus a confirmation alert in group admin
rationale: One irreversible call behind a confirm alert.

name: Create a new channel
uiSurface: New Channel flow: name/description form, then a type screen, then an invite-members screen
rationale: A multi-step creation wizard with photo picking and downscaling on a 512MB device; each call is simple but the flow is new UI.

name: Channel description and photo editing
uiSurface: Editable title field, multi-line description text view and photo cell in the channel edit screen
rationale: Plain form fields; photo must be downscaled before upload but that path exists for message photos.

name: Sponsored messages in channel feed
uiSurface: Ad bubble appended after the last message in channel chats with a sponsor button and a report menu
rationale: Deliberately out of scope: rendering ads in a third-party legacy client provides no user value, and reporting/hiding paths need Premium; the owner-side toggleSupergroupCanHaveSponsoredMessages could be shipped alone as a trivial admin toggle if wanted.

name: Channel ad revenue statistics and withdrawal
uiSurface: "Monetization" screen with balance card, transaction list and a withdraw button
rationale: Withdrawal requires a password-confirmed web checkout at Fragment which needs a real browser view; iOS 6 has no WKWebView and the flow is a payment surface we should not fake.

name: Star revenue statistics for channel
uiSurface: Stars balance and transaction list rows inside the monetization screen
rationale: Read-only balance and transaction rows are technically feasible without any payment flow, but need a new screen and the graphs would be omitted.

name: Paid reactions on channel posts
uiSurface: Star reaction button with a paid-amount slider sheet under channel posts
rationale: Sending requires a Stars balance, and topping up needs an in-app purchase flow this client cannot provide; display of an existing paid-reaction count could be added later as a plain counter.

name: Channel giveaways and prepaid giveaways
uiSurface: Giveaway creation wizard from the boost screen and a giveaway result bubble in chat
rationale: Creating a giveaway is an in-app purchase of Premium/Stars, unavailable here; rendering an incoming messageGiveaway bubble as a plain informational card plus getGiveawayInfo is separable and would be trivial.

name: Inactive channels cleanup prompt
uiSurface: List of inactive channels with a leave action, surfaced when channel creation hits the limit
rationale: leaveChat is wrapped; the list is a plain chat table.

name: Automatic translation of channel posts
uiSurface: Toggle in channel admin plus a "Translate" bar above the chat
rationale: The admin toggle is one call, but the reader-side translation bar and per-message translated text swap is real chat-view plumbing.

name: Channel post scheduling and silent posting
uiSurface: Long-press on the send button giving "Send Silently" / "Schedule" options, plus a scheduled-messages screen
rationale: sendMessage is wrapped but scheduling needs a date picker sheet and a separate scheduled-messages list screen.

name: Channel sticker set / custom emoji set for discussion group
uiSurface: "Group Sticker Set" row with a set search field in group admin
rationale: Sticker set search UI already needed for stickers area; the setter is one call. Custom emoji half is inert without animated emoji rendering.

name: Join to send messages (discussion group gate)
uiSurface: Toggle row in the linked group's admin screen
rationale: One boolean call.

name: Chat boost event in message feed
uiSurface: Centered service-message line in chat ("X boosted the channel")
rationale: One more case in the existing service-message text builder.

name: Sender boost badge on discussion group messages
uiSurface: Small boost icon with count next to the sender name in group bubbles
rationale: Field already on the message; a small badge in the bubble header.

name: Edit group/channel title
uiSurface: Text field row in a new "Edit group" screen pushed from the group profile (TGProfileViewController)
rationale: Single string call; TGClient has generic request:completion: and TGEditProfileViewController is a copy-paste template for a one-field editor.

name: Edit group/channel description (About)
uiSurface: Multiline text view row on the same Edit group screen; description shown on group profile header
rationale: getSupergroupFullInfo is already wrapped for member counts, so the read side exists; write is one call.

name: Set / remove group photo
uiSurface: Tappable avatar on Edit group screen -> action sheet (Take Photo / Choose / Remove) -> UIImagePickerController
rationale: Needs picker plumbing plus square crop and downscale before upload on a 512MB device; sendPhotoAtPath shows the upload path but not the crop UI.

name: Default chat permissions (restrict everyone)
uiSurface: "Permissions" grouped table with ~10 switches (send messages, media, polls, links, pin, change info, invite, topics) plus a members-restricted counter
rationale: 16-field struct with implied dependencies (media sub-toggles collapse under one parent row in modern clients); needs a real layout decision, not one row.

name: Slow mode delay
uiSurface: Row on Permissions screen opening an action sheet of presets (Off/10s/30s/1m/5m/15m/1h)
rationale: Fixed preset list, one int call; TGActionSheet already exists for exactly this pattern.

name: Copy / share primary invite link
uiSurface: Single row on group profile showing the t.me link, tap -> action sheet Copy / Share / Revoke
rationale: One read call plus UIPasteboard; no list UI needed for the primary link alone.

name: Invite link manager (create, edit, revoke, delete)
uiSurface: "Invite Links" list screen (active/revoked sections) plus a link editor with name, expiry date picker, member limit, request-approval switch
rationale: Two new screens, a date picker and a paginated list keyed on offset_invite_link; genuinely new UI.

name: Members who joined via a link
uiSurface: Member list section inside the link detail screen, reusing the contacts cell
rationale: Depends on the invite link manager screens existing; paginated with a struct offset.

name: Open / preview / join by invite link (t.me/+hash)
uiSurface: Preview alert (title, photo, member count) with Join button, triggered from the QR scanner and from tapped links in chat
rationale: TGQRViewController already parses t.me/ URLs and TGAlertView can carry the confirm; two calls total.

name: Join requests inbox (approve / decline)
uiSurface: "N join requests" row on group profile opening a list of user rows with Approve/Dismiss buttons and bio text; plus an in-chat banner
rationale: New cell type with two inline buttons and an update-driven badge; not a plain table row.

name: Require admin approval to join / join-to-send
uiSurface: Two switch rows on the group type / permissions screen
rationale: Boolean toggles on supergroup_id, already-known id from getSupergroupFullInfo usage.

name: Public link / username for group or channel
uiSurface: "Group Type" screen: Private/Public segmented choice, username field with live availability label, and a "too many public links" list
rationale: setUsername:completion: for the account already exists as a direct template; validation is one extra call and a colored label.

name: Chat history visibility for new members
uiSurface: Two-option radio rows (Visible / Hidden) on the Group Type screen
rationale: Single boolean; only caveat is it is rejected for public groups, so show a disabled state.

name: Channel signatures / show sender
uiSurface: Switch row on channel admin screen
rationale: Two booleans in one call.

name: Restrict content saving/forwarding
uiSurface: Switch row on Permissions screen
rationale: One boolean; the client only needs to honour it by hiding Forward/Save actions.

name: Hide member list
uiSurface: Switch row on Permissions screen
rationale: Boolean toggle; hidden state simply yields an empty getSupergroupMembers for non-admins.

name: Aggressive anti-spam + report false positive
uiSurface: Switch row on Permissions screen; "Report as not spam" in the event log row action sheet
rationale: Boolean plus a fire-and-forget call; server enforces the member-count minimum and returns an error we can surface.

name: Message auto-delete timer for a chat
uiSurface: Existing row on chat profile; extend preset list
rationale: Already wrapped as setChat:autoDeleteSeconds: in TGClient.

name: Delete / leave / clear chat
uiSurface: Existing swipe action and profile action sheet
