rationale: deleteChat:, clearHistoryInChat: and setChat:joined: already exist in TGClient.

name: Admin list and rights editor
uiSurface: "Administrators" list plus a per-admin rights screen with ~10 switches and a custom title field
rationale: Rights struct differs between group and channel, needs a can_be_edited-aware read-only mode; substantial new UI.

name: Ban / kick / restrict a member
uiSurface: Long-press action sheet on a member row: Remove from group / Ban; full restriction editor deferred
rationale: Kick and ban are one call each from an action sheet; the per-user permission matrix is the design-bucket admin editor above.

name: Removed users (blacklist) list
uiSurface: Filtered member list screen with unban swipe
rationale: getSupergroupMembers is already issued in TGClient; only the filter argument and a swipe action are new.

name: Member search inside a chat
uiSurface: Search bar above the existing members list
rationale: One call, reuses the member cell and the search bar pattern from TGSearchViewController.

name: Add members to a group
uiSurface: Multi-select contact picker pushed from the members list, plus a failure alert for privacy-restricted users
rationale: Needs a multi-select variant of the contacts screen (TGContactsViewController is single-select) and failedToAddMembers handling.

name: Create new group / channel
uiSurface: Two-step flow: member multi-picker then title/photo screen; entry from the chat list compose button
rationale: Multi-step new flow sharing the multi-select picker; upgrade-to-supergroup must be offered transparently when a basic-group action fails.

name: Chat event log (recent actions)
uiSurface: Chronological list screen with a filter sheet (event categories + admin picker); each row renders one of ~45 chatEventAction variants
rationale: Rendering the action union readably is the whole feature; modern clients render it as service messages inside a chat view, which is a large plumbing decision for us.

name: Transfer chat ownership
uiSurface: Destructive row in the admin rights screen -> 2FA password prompt -> confirmation alert
rationale: Requires a password entry sheet and handling four distinct canTransferOwnership results (password too fresh / session too fresh).

name: Link a discussion group to a channel
uiSurface: "Discussion" row on channel profile opening a picker of eligible groups
rationale: Needs a dedicated chat picker fed by getSuitableDiscussionChats plus a create-group escape hatch.

name: Group sticker set
uiSurface: "Group Stickers" screen: short-name field plus a preview grid of the set
rationale: Requires a sticker-set preview grid; sticker rendering exists only for the recent-stickers path today.

name: Allowed reactions in a chat
uiSurface: "Reactions" screen: All/Some/Disabled radio plus an emoji multi-select list
rationale: Emoji multi-select grid is new UI; the write call itself is simple.

name: Convert channel comments group to a broadcast group (gigagroup)
uiSurface: Irreversible-action row with a confirm alert on the group management screen
rationale: Single no-argument toggle guarded by one confirmation alert.

name: Convert group to forum with topics
uiSurface: Switch row on group management; topic list already exists in TGTopicsViewController
rationale: TGClient already tracks is_forum per supergroup and TGTopicsViewController renders topics, so only the toggle and a create-topic form are missing.

name: Set chat location (location-based group)
uiSurface: Map picker plus address field on the group type screen
rationale: MapKit works on iOS 6 but a pin-drop picker with reverse-geocoded address is real new UI for a niche feature.

name: Post as channel (message sender in a chat)
uiSurface: Avatar button inside the compose bar opening a sender list sheet
rationale: Touches the compose bar layout and the outgoing-message path, not just a settings row.

name: Report a chat or chat photo
uiSurface: "Report" action sheet driven by the server-returned option list, with an optional free-text step
rationale: The modern report flow is a server-driven multi-step wizard (options -> sub-options -> text), so it needs a small state machine, not a static sheet.

name: Per-chat wallpaper
uiSurface: "Chat Background" row leading to a wallpaper grid
rationale: Needs a thumbnail grid and per-chat background plumbing through TGTheme/TGChatViewController, plus aggressive downscaling on a 4S.

name: Chat accent color, profile accent color, emoji status
uiSurface: Color/emoji picker on channel appearance screen
rationale: Gated behind channel boost levels the account will not have, and the visual payload is animated custom emoji which the 4S cannot render at acceptable cost; also alien to the 2013 visual language we are targeting.

name: Channel boosts, boost-gated unrestrict count, sponsored message controls
uiSurface: Boost status screen with level meter
rationale: Boosting requires an active Telegram Premium subscription and server-side boost state we cannot provision; the whole surface would render empty.

name: Similar channels recommendation strip
uiSurface: Horizontal card strip at the end of a channel profile
rationale: Full list is Premium-only (returns a truncated teaser otherwise) and a horizontally scrolling avatar-card strip is a post-2013 idiom with no UICollectionView available.

name: Privacy rules for Last Seen / Photo / Calls / Groups / Forwards / Phone / Bio
uiSurface: Privacy and Security screen: one grouped table row per setting pushing a 3-option radio list (Everybody / My Contacts / Nobody)
rationale: TGClient already wraps get/set at TGClient.m:2063 and :2087; each setting is a radio table, exactly the 2013 design.

name: Privacy exception lists (Always Allow / Never Allow specific users)
uiSurface: Two sub-rows under each privacy setting showing counts, each opening a multi-select contact picker
rationale: Needs a reusable multi-select contact picker and rule-array merge logic, not a single toggle.

name: Peer-to-peer call privacy
uiSurface: Radio row inside the Calls privacy submenu
rationale: Same wrapper, different setting constant; row-only UI.

name: Voice/video message privacy (premium-gated)
uiSurface: Radio row on Privacy screen
rationale: Server rejects setting it without an active Telegram Premium subscription (premiumFeature), which we cannot obtain.

name: Read receipts / read date privacy
uiSurface: Single UISwitch row on Privacy screen
rationale: Setting show_read_date to false is premium-only server-side; only reading the current value would work, so the toggle is useless.

name: Restrict new chats from unknown users
uiSurface: UISwitch row on Privacy screen
rationale: allow_new_chats_from_unknown_users=false is a premium-gated server restriction; the paid-messages half is Stars-only.

name: Blocked users list
uiSurface: Blocked Users table pushed from Privacy screen: avatar + name + phone cell, swipe-to-delete
rationale: Wrapped at TGClient.m:2097; a plain table of senders with an empty-state label.

name: Block / unblock a sender
uiSurface: Action-sheet item on the user profile screen and delete action in the Blocked list
rationale: Wrapped at TGClient.m:1472 plus isUserBlocked: in TGClient.h:342; both call sites are single rows.

name: Add user to blocked list via contact picker
uiSurface: Plus button in the Blocked Users nav bar opening the existing contact picker
rationale: Reuses the contact picker we already have and the existing block wrapper.

name: Stories block list
uiSurface: Second segment on the Blocked list
rationale: We do not implement stories at all on this client, so a stories-only block list has no surface to attach to.

name: Active sessions list
uiSurface: Sessions screen: 'current session' header block plus a grouped list of other sessions with app name, device, IP and location subtitle
rationale: Wrapped at TGClient.m:1571; purely a grouped table with two-line cells.

name: Terminate one session / terminate all other sessions
uiSurface: Swipe-delete on a session row plus a red 'Terminate All Other Sessions' button row with a UIActionSheet confirm
rationale: terminateSession: exists at TGClient.m:1588; terminateAllOtherSessions is a one-line wrapper.

name: Session detail: allow calls / allow secret chats toggles
uiSurface: Pushed session detail screen with two UISwitch rows
rationale: Needs a whole new detail screen that the 2013 client never had; layout must be designed.

name: Auto-terminate old sessions after N days
uiSurface: Row on Sessions screen showing the current TTL, pushing a radio list (1 week / 1 month / 3 months / 6 months)
rationale: One wrapper plus a radio list; the current value already arrives inside the sessions object.

name: Unconfirmed session banner and confirm/terminate
uiSurface: Yellow banner above the chat list with Confirm / Terminate actions
rationale: Requires a new persistent banner view in the chat list and update-event handling.

name: Connected websites (Telegram Login)
uiSurface: Section under Sessions listing domain + bot + last active, swipe to disconnect, plus 'Disconnect All'
rationale: Two read-only calls and a delete; same table pattern as sessions.

name: Two-step verification status
uiSurface: Row on Privacy screen with On/Off detail label, pushing the 2SV screen
rationale: Single request returning a struct that drives a detail label.

name: Set / change / disable 2-step verification password
uiSurface: Multi-step wizard: enter password, re-enter, hint, recovery email; plus a 'Turn Password Off' red row
rationale: A genuine multi-screen flow with validation and error states, not a single row.

name: Recovery email address (get / set / verify code)
uiSurface: Email entry screen plus a 6-digit code entry screen inside the 2SV flow
rationale: Two new entry screens with code-resend timer and pending-state handling.

name: Password recovery at login (forgot password)
uiSurface: 'Forgot password?' link on the existing auth password screen leading to code entry and new-password entry
rationale: Touches the auth state machine (TGAuthStateWaitPassword) and needs new screens plus the week-long pending reset countdown.

name: Login email address
uiSurface: Row inside 2SV / account settings with an email + code flow
rationale: Only changeable when the account already has a login email set on a modern client; unusable entry point here and easy to lock the user out.

name: Temporary password for payments
uiSurface: Password prompt inside a payment confirmation flow
rationale: Only meaningful with the payments UI, which this client does not implement.

name: Local passcode lock (app-level PIN)
uiSurface: Passcode Lock screen: enable/disable, change passcode, auto-lock interval radio list, plus a full-screen keypad lock overlay on foreground
rationale: Purely client-side (no TDLib call); needs a keypad view, keychain storage and app-lifecycle locking, exactly as the 2013 client had it.

name: Account self-destruct TTL
uiSurface: Row on Privacy screen with the current period, pushing a radio list (1/3/6/12 months)
rationale: Both wrapped at TGClient.m:2117 and :2122; radio list only.

name: Delete account
uiSurface: Red destructive row at the bottom of Privacy with a UIActionSheet confirm and an optional reason field
rationale: One wrapper and a confirm sheet; only risk is accidental taps, handled by the sheet.

name: Default auto-delete timer for new chats
uiSurface: Row on Privacy screen pushing a radio list (Off / 1 day / 1 week / 1 month)
rationale: Two one-line wrappers; per-chat variant setChatMessageAutoDeleteTime is already wrapped at TGClient.m:2022.

name: Per-chat auto-delete timer
uiSurface: Row in the chat info screen with a period picker
rationale: Already wrapped (TGClient.h:195, TGClient.m:2022); needs only the info-screen row.

name: Report a chat or user for spam/abuse
uiSurface: 'Report' action-sheet item on profile/chat info, then an options list and optional comment field
rationale: The modern report flow is a multi-step server-driven option tree, so it needs a small driven-list screen rather than one sheet.

name: Sponsored messages toggle
uiSurface: UISwitch row on Privacy screen
rationale: Disabling sponsored messages is premium-only and we never render sponsored messages anyway.

name: Autosave gifts / gift privacy
uiSurface: Radio rows on Privacy screen
rationale: Belongs to the Stars/gifts economy which this client does not and will not implement.

name: Last seen / online text for a user
uiSurface: subtitle label in chat navigation bar, chat list row and profile header
rationale: TGClient.m already formats all six UserStatus variants (lines 590-640, 1753-1790) and posts TGUserStatusDidChangeNotification; only remaining work is consistent placement.

name: Live status updates via updateUserStatus
uiSurface: no new UI; notification-driven refresh of existing labels
rationale: Update is already consumed and cached into chat dicts with an isOnline flag.

name: Green online dot on chat list and profile avatars
uiSurface: small badge overlay drawn on the avatar view in chat list cells and contacts list
rationale: Data is present but requires a new avatar-overlay drawing path in the cell, and 2014 Telegram had no such dot so the visual has to be designed rather than copied.

name: Relative 'last seen' time formatting (today/yesterday/date)
uiSurface: same subtitle label; formatting-only
rationale: Pure NSDateFormatter work on was_online, matching the original client's 'last seen at 14:32' / 'last seen Jan 5' wording.

name: 'Last seen recently' hidden-because-you-hid-yours hint
uiSurface: alert or inline note when tapping the status label
rationale: by_my_privacy_settings is already in the payload; showing an explanatory alert is a one-method change.

name: Last Seen & Online privacy setting
uiSurface: Everybody/My Contacts/Nobody selection table in Settings > Privacy
rationale: TGClient exposes setPrivacyRule:to: and the generic getter; the ShowStatus key already routes correctly.

name: Privacy exception lists (Always/Never share status)
uiSurface: two 'Add Users' sub-screens with contact multi-select feeding an id list
rationale: Current wrapper only sends a single scalar rule; supporting user-id vectors needs a new rules encoder plus a contact multi-picker screen.

name: Other status-adjacent privacy toggles (profile photo, phone, bio, calls, invites)
uiSurface: additional rows in the same Privacy table
rationale: Identical shape to ShowStatus and the existing generic setPrivacyRule:to: already accepts these setting names.

name: Mark self online/offline on app foreground/background
uiSurface: none, lifecycle glue in app delegate
rationale: setOption is already wrapped; toggling the 'online' option in applicationDidBecomeActive/DidEnterBackground is a few lines and is what makes our own status correct for peers.

name: openChat/closeChat to receive fine-grained status and member counts
uiSurface: none, controller lifecycle glue
rationale: Two one-line request wrappers called from viewWillAppear/viewWillDisappear; TDLib only pushes precise status and online counts for opened chats.

name: 'N members, M online' group header subtitle
uiSurface: navigation bar subtitle in group chats and group profile header
rationale: One update handler storing an int on the chat dict plus a label string; matches the original 2014 group header exactly.

name: Show other users' emoji status (badge next to name)
uiSurface: small square icon after the title in chat list rows, chat header and profile name
rationale: Needs a new custom-emoji id to sticker resolver, a thumbnail cache and inline icon layout in three existing title layouts; animation must be dropped in favour of the static webp/png thumbnail on a 4S.

name: Set my own emoji status
uiSurface: emoji picker sheet from the profile header
rationale: setEmojiStatus is rejected by the server for non-Premium accounts, so the whole picker would be dead UI for our users.

name: Emoji status expiration countdown
uiSurface: timer text under the status badge in profile
rationale: Only meaningful once we can set a status, which requires Premium; displaying another user's expiry has no value.

name: Upgraded-gift emoji status (collectible badge with backdrop colours)
uiSurface: gradient-backed badge plus a gift info sheet on the profile screen
rationale: Requires the whole gifts/collectibles subsystem and animated model+symbol custom emoji layering; far beyond the 4S render budget and the client's scope.

name: Display peer accent colour on names and reply/quote bars
uiSurface: name label colour in chat list and group messages, reply-line and link colour inside bubbles
rationale: Needs a palette store fed by updateAccentColors with light-theme colour vectors, mapping into TGTheme and every place a peer name is drawn; a genuine plumbing change but perfectly possible on iOS 6.

name: Set my own accent colour / name colour
uiSurface: horizontal colour swatch picker in Settings > Appearance
rationale: setAccentColor is a Premium-only feature (premiumFeatureAccentColor); the server rejects it for free accounts.

name: Profile accent colour and profile header gradient
uiSurface: tinted gradient behind the avatar and name in the profile header
rationale: Reading and rendering another user's profile colours is free; it needs a new gradient-drawing header view, and it must be reconciled with the flat 2014 profile design before it is worth doing.

name: Set my own profile accent colour
uiSurface: colour picker in profile edit
rationale: Premium-gated on the server, same as setAccentColor.

name: Profile background custom emoji pattern
uiSurface: tiled, low-alpha emoji pattern layer inside the profile header behind the avatar
rationale: Displaying someone else's pattern is technically possible from static thumbnails, but tiling dozens of decoded images on 512MB is expensive and the layer needs a downscaled, pre-rendered single tile image; setting one's own is Premium-only.

name: Channel/group emoji status and accent colour display
uiSurface: same title badge and header tint, on chat rows and channel profile
rationale: Display shares the peer-colour and custom-emoji plumbing above; the setters additionally require chat boost level so only the read path is worth building.

name: Premium badge / verified mark next to a name
uiSurface: small glyph after the name in chat list, header and profile
rationale: Flags are already in the cached user dictionary; drawing a static asset glyph is a small layout addition and the 2014 client already had a verified badge to copy.

name: Hide my last seen while still seeing others (Premium last-seen times)
uiSurface: informational row in Privacy settings
rationale: Reciprocity is enforced server-side; only Premium accounts get exact times while hiding their own.

name: Contacts list sorted by last seen with status subtitles
uiSurface: subtitle line per row in the contacts table, with a sort using the existing status rank
rationale: TGClient already computes a numeric rank alongside the status text, which is exactly what the sort needs.

name: Enable secret chat support in TDLib
uiSurface: no UI; one parameter flip in TGClient setTdlibParameters (currently use_secret_chats:@NO)
rationale: Everything else in this area is dead until this flag is YES; TGClient.m:490 hardcodes @NO.

name: Start a new secret chat with a user
uiSurface: 'New Secret Chat' row in the contacts picker / an action-sheet button on TGProfileViewController, then push TGChatViewController on the returned chat
rationale: Single request returning a chat; entry point is one table row plus one action sheet item.

name: Open/rejoin an existing secret chat by secret_chat_id
uiSurface: internal only — resolving chatTypeSecret.secret_chat_id from updates or deep links into a Chat object
rationale: Plain wrapper, no UI of its own.

name: Close/terminate a secret chat
uiSurface: destructive row in the secret-chat profile screen and a swipe/long-press action in TGChatListViewController
rationale: One method plus a confirm alert; deleteChatHistory is already wrapped.

name: Secret chat state tracking (pending / ready / closed)
uiSurface: a per-chat state cache in TGClient plus a status line in the chat header ('waiting for X to come online', 'cancelled') and input-bar disabling
rationale: Needs a new secret-chat model store, an update handler, and header/input-bar states that do not exist today.

name: Secret-chat visual identity (green lock, green title, green chat-list row)
uiSurface: lock glyph plus green title colour in TGChatListViewController cells, chat nav-bar title, and the profile header
rationale: New icon asset and colour treatment across three screens; the 2013 client made this its most recognizable visual cue.

name: Encryption key visualization / key hash comparison
uiSurface: a dedicated 'Encryption Key' screen drawing the 36-byte key_hash as a 12x12 four-colour pixel grid plus explanatory text
rationale: Requires a custom drawRect view and bit-unpacking of key_hash into the four fixed colours; cheap on CPU but genuinely new UI.

name: Per-chat self-destruct timer (TTL) picker
uiSurface: TGActionSheet with the classic ladder (Off, 1s, 2s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 1m, 1h, 1d, 1w) opened from the clock button in the chat nav bar / input bar
rationale: setChatMessageAutoDeleteTime is already wrapped (TGClient.m:2020); only the action sheet and the clock button are missing, and updateChatMessageAutoDeleteTime needs a one-line handler.

name: TTL-change service message in the timeline
uiSurface: centered service-message row in TGChatViewController ('X set the self-destruct timer to 5 seconds')
rationale: One more branch in the existing service-message formatter beside messageScreenshotTaken.

name: Global default auto-delete timer
uiSurface: Privacy section row in TGSettingsViewController with the same duration action sheet
rationale: Two thin wrappers and a settings row reusing the TTL picker.

name: Self-destruct countdown on messages
uiSurface: burning-fuse / shrinking-clock indicator inside ChatViewCell plus a local timer that removes the row when it hits zero
rationale: Needs new cell artwork and a per-visible-cell tick timer; must be a single shared NSTimer on the 4S, not one per cell, or the single-core A5 stutters.

name: Mark self-destructing content as opened (starts the timer)
uiSurface: called when a photo/voice/video-note bubble is tapped or a secret media viewer opens
rationale: One-line wrapper hooked into the existing tap handlers; without it the timer never starts.

name: Send self-destructing photo
uiSurface: a timer toggle in the photo-send confirmation, adding self_destruct_type to the existing inputMessagePhoto dictionary
rationale: inputMessagePhoto is already built in TGClient; only an extra optional key plus one toggle.

name: Send self-destructing voice note / video note
uiSurface: long-press option on the record button, or automatic when the chat TTL is set
rationale: Voice notes are already recorded and sent by TGVoiceRecorder/TGClient; adding self_destruct_type is one key.

name: Send self-destructing video
uiSurface: same timer toggle on the video-send path
rationale: The 4S can only send camera-roll H.264 it did not re-encode; the toggle is cheap but the video send path itself needs the secret-chat local-file-only rules (no server file reuse).

name: Expired media placeholders
uiSurface: italic grey placeholder bubble in ChatViewCell
rationale: TGClient.m:895 already collapses the messageExpired* prefix to 'Expired media'; only per-type wording and a bubble style remain.

name: Blurred tap-to-view secret media (is_secret)
uiSurface: blurred/obscured thumbnail with a 'Tap to view' overlay that reveals full-screen only while held
rationale: Requires a hold-to-view full-screen viewer and a cheap blur (downscale + upscale, not CoreImage) because iOS 6 has no UIVisualEffectView and the 4S has little memory.

name: Incoming screenshot notification
uiSurface: centered service row 'X took a screenshot!'
rationale: Already handled at TGClient.m:804; needs only proper wording and styling.

name: Outgoing screenshot detection
uiSurface: none — would fire automatically while a secret chat is on screen
rationale: UIApplicationUserDidTakeScreenshotNotification is iOS 7+, and current TDLib exposes no sendChatScreenshotTakenNotification function in the schema, so we can neither detect nor report it.

name: New-secret-chat notification handling
uiSurface: local notification text and a chat-list row highlight when an incoming secret chat request arrives
rationale: One branch in notification formatting; the chat already arrives via updateNewChat.

name: Allow/deny this session to accept secret chats
uiSurface: switch row in the session detail view of TGSessionsViewController
rationale: Sessions list is already fetched via getActiveSessions; this is one wrapper and one UISwitch cell.

name: Account self-destruct period
uiSurface: Privacy settings row with 1/3/6/12-month action sheet
rationale: Both calls are already wrapped in TGClient (accountTtlWithCompletion / setAccountTtl); only the row and sheet are needed.

name: Secret-chat capability gating by peer layer
uiSurface: hides reply/rich-entity/edit affordances when the partner's layer is too low
rationale: A couple of integer comparisons in the chat controller once secretChat is cached.

name: Secret-chat send restrictions
uiSurface: grey out polls/checklists/story-forwards/quoted replies in the attachment sheet and forward picker for chatTypeSecret targets
rationale: Pure guard clauses in TGForwardPicker and the attachment sheet; without them TDLib returns errors the user cannot interpret.

name: No message editing or scheduling in secret chats
uiSurface: hide Edit and Schedule from the message context menu for secret chats; keep Delete with revoke:true
rationale: Menu-item filtering only; deleteMessages and editMessageText are already wrapped.

name: Local database encryption key
uiSurface: none visible; a keychain-backed random key generated on first launch
rationale: Needs Keychain plumbing and a migration path for existing installs whose database was created with an empty key — getting it wrong wipes the local DB.

name: Secret-chat file handling
uiSurface: none — download/cache path must not reuse remote file ids across secret chats and must skip these types in TGStorageViewController's reusable cache stats
rationale: downloadFile is already wrapped; this is a filtering rule in the cache/storage code.

name: Outgoing 1-to-1 voice call
uiSurface: already-existing TGCallViewController full-screen call screen, launched from profile 'Call' row
rationale: TGCall.mm already issues createCall with a hardcoded is_video:NO and drives libtgvoip; only entry points and polish remain.

name: Incoming call ring + accept/decline
uiSurface: incoming call screen with Accept/Decline, plus local notification when backgrounded
rationale: acceptCall and discardCall are already wrapped in TGCall.mm; missing piece is only the incoming presentation path and a local notification (no VoIP push on iOS 6).

name: Call signaling data channel
uiSurface: none, transport only
rationale: Both directions are already plumbed through TGClient.m updateNewCallSignalingData into TGCall.

name: Emoji key verification (call fingerprint)
uiSurface: four emoji shown at top of the active call screen with a tap-to-explain alert
rationale: callStateReady.emojis arrives in the update TGCall already parses; it is a label plus an alert.

name: Mute microphone and speakerphone toggle
uiSurface: two toggle buttons on the call screen
rationale: Purely local: setMuted: exists on TGCall, speaker is an AVAudioSession override route change; no TDLib call involved.

name: End call with correct discard reason and duration
uiSurface: end-call button plus a status line reflecting the reason
rationale: discardCall is wrapped; only duration/connection_id bookkeeping and reason mapping need finishing.

name: Call quality rating prompt
uiSurface: star-rating alert after call end plus a problem-checkbox action sheet when rating is low
rationale: callStateDiscarded.need_rating already arrives; one TGClient wrapper plus a simple stars alert.

name: Call debug information and log upload
uiSurface: none, silent background submit when need_debug_information/need_log is set
rationale: libtgvoip already produces a debug string; one wrapper each, no UI.

name: Call log / recent calls list
uiSurface: a Calls tab or a Recent Calls screen listing call messages with direction icon, plus 'Clear' and an only-missed filter
rationale: searchCallMessages is unwrapped and this is a whole new list screen with its own cell layout, matching the 2013 Recent Calls tab.

name: Call bubbles inside chat history
uiSurface: in-chat call row with direction arrow, duration and tap-to-call-back
rationale: TGClient.m already renders messageCall to an 'Outgoing/Missed call' row with a callState field; only the icon and tap action are missing.

name: Call-back from a past call message
uiSurface: tap on a call row in chat or in the call log
rationale: Reuses the existing createCall path; inputCallFromMessage is only needed for late rating/debug submission.

name: Callability gating (can_be_called / privacy restricted)
uiSurface: show/hide the Call row on the profile screen and an explanatory alert on refusal
rationale: TGClient.m already exposes canCall and canVideoCall from userFullInfo; it is a row visibility condition.

name: Calls privacy settings (who can call me, P2P)
uiSurface: two rows in Settings > Privacy leading to Everybody/Contacts/Nobody pickers with exception lists
rationale: The rule-vector encoding plus exception pickers is real plumbing, though the picker itself is a plain table.

name: Use less data for calls
uiSurface: a Never/On mobile/Always segmented row in Settings > Data and Storage
rationale: use_less_data_for_calls is one boolean inside autoDownloadSettings and libtgvoip already accepts a data-saving mode.

name: Per-session 'accept calls on this device' toggle
uiSurface: a switch row on the active-session detail screen
rationale: Single boolean call against a session id; the sessions screen already exists in the settings area.

name: Call network usage statistics
uiSurface: a 'Calls' line with sent/received bytes and total duration in a Network Usage screen
rationale: One read call and a couple of formatted labels.

name: Upgrade a 1-to-1 call into a group call
uiSurface: an 'Add participant' button on the call screen
rationale: Group calls require the modern tgcalls WebRTC stack (SFU, DTLS-SRTP, simulcast) which does not exist for us; our media layer is libtgvoip 1-to-1 reflector only.

name: 1-to-1 video call
uiSurface: full-screen remote video with a PiP local preview and a camera-flip button
rationale: Video calls need tgcalls with VP8/H.264 realtime encode; the vendored libtgvoip build is audio-only and a single-core A5 under iOS 6 has no usable realtime encoder API, so is_video must stay NO.

name: Join / leave a video chat in a group
uiSurface: a video chat bar at the top of the group chat and a participants screen
rationale: joinVideoChat requires a WebRTC join payload produced by tgcalls; without that stack the join cannot be constructed at all.

name: Create / schedule / start / end a video chat
uiSurface: group profile action sheet plus a scheduling sheet
rationale: Creating one without being able to join it is a dead end; the whole feature depends on the missing media stack.

name: Video chat participant management (mute, volume, raise hand, ban, invite)
uiSurface: participants table inside the video chat screen with per-row action sheet
rationale: Only meaningful while joined to a call we cannot join.

name: Video chat / live stream playback (RTMP, stream segments)
uiSurface: a live-stream player screen
rationale: Segments are WebM/VP8+Opus needing realtime demux and decode plus a WebRTC-derived join; the 4S under iOS 6 has no path to decode this in software at rate.

name: Group call service messages in chat history
uiSurface: grey centered service lines in the chat, same style as other service messages
rationale: Rendering the text is independent of being able to join; TGClient's service-message formatter just needs these five cases added.

name: Decline a group call invitation from a message
uiSurface: a Decline button on the incoming group-call message row
rationale: A one-argument call that lets us politely refuse calls we cannot join, which is better than silently ignoring them.

name: Group call invite links (open / preview)
uiSurface: link preview cell and an alert when such a link is tapped
rationale: We can parse and preview the link, but tapping must end in an explanatory 'not supported on this device' alert, which needs a deliberate decision.

name: Live story group calls, paid group-call messages and reactions
uiSurface: live story viewer with chat overlay
rationale: Depends on both the missing WebRTC stack and on Telegram Stars payments, neither of which is reachable here.

name: End-to-end encrypted group call data (encrypt/decrypt helpers)
uiSurface: none
rationale: Only used by a WebRTC media pipeline we do not have.

name: Top-called contacts suggestion
uiSurface: a frequently-called row strip at the top of the call log or contact picker
rationale: One read call returning chat ids we can already render as contact rows.

name: Active stories list (story tray)
uiSurface: horizontal avatar-ring strip pinned above the chat list on the Dialogs screen, plus a model that keeps chatActiveStories in memory
rationale: Needs a whole new scrollable ring tray, unread ring drawing and an update-driven model; nothing like it exists in our client.

name: Story viewer (photo stories)
uiSurface: full-screen modal viewer with segmented progress bar, tap-to-advance, caption overlay, poster header; pushed from the tray
rationale: Entirely new full-screen player with gesture paging and timers; photo-only is feasible on a 4S if images are downscaled before display.

name: Video story playback
uiSurface: AVPlayer layer inside the story viewer
rationale: Decode of short H.264 MP4 works on a 4S via AVPlayer, but only for the low-res alternative_video; must never preload the main quality. Risky but not impossible, so design, not blocked.

name: Marking stories read / unread ring state
uiSurface: no UI of its own; drives ring colour in the tray and avatar rings on profiles
rationale: Two one-line request wrappers plus reading max_read_story_id from the update.

name: Story reactions (quick reaction + picker)
uiSurface: heart button in the story viewer footer and a small reaction strip on long-press
rationale: Calls are simple but the reaction strip needs new overlay UI inside the (new) viewer.

name: Reply to a story from the viewer
uiSurface: text field pinned at the bottom of the story viewer, sends into the poster's private chat
rationale: Reply-to plumbing exists for messages but the story reply-to variant and the in-viewer composer are new.

name: Story shared as a chat message bubble
uiSurface: new message cell type in the chat history plus a share sheet entry
rationale: TGClient already labels messageStory as "Story" but there is no cell rendering; needs a real bubble with the story thumbnail.

name: Forward / repost a story
uiSurface: share action sheet in the viewer; repost reuses the post composer
rationale: Repost is postStory with from_story_full_id and therefore depends on the whole posting flow.

name: Post a photo story
uiSurface: camera/library picker then a full-screen composer with caption field, privacy row and Post button
rationale: Multi-screen new flow; photo capture and upload are within a 4S's ability.

name: Post a video story
uiSurface: video capture plus trim UI in the composer
rationale: A 4S can capture 1080p but the client must transcode/trim to the story profile; no usable trimming stack on iOS 6 within 512MB, and uploads of that size are impractical. Photo stories only.

name: Live stories (RTMP / group-call based)
uiSurface: live viewer with WebRTC/HLS video and a donor list
rationale: Requires the group-call/WebRTC stack and real-time video decode; not achievable on iOS 6 / A5 in this client.

name: Story caption with entities
uiSurface: caption label overlaid at the bottom of the viewer, expandable on tap
rationale: Plain rendering of formattedText we already handle for messages; links/formatting on posting is premium-gated but display is free.

name: Delete own story
uiSurface: action sheet item in the viewer / my-stories list
rationale: One-line request plus an action sheet with confirmation.

name: Edit own story (caption / content)
uiSurface: reopens the post composer prefilled
rationale: Depends on the composer; caption-only edit could later be split out as a simple text screen.

name: Story privacy settings (Everyone / Contacts / Close Friends / Selected)
uiSurface: grouped table with four radio rows plus an exception contact picker; reachable from the composer and from the viewer action sheet
rationale: A radio-row UITableView plus our existing contact multi-picker; the call is one dictionary.

name: Close Friends list
uiSurface: contact multi-select screen under Privacy settings
rationale: Standard contact picker writing back a user id vector.

name: Hide stories from a user (stories block list)
uiSurface: action-sheet item in the viewer plus a "Hidden" list in Privacy settings
rationale: Reuses the block-list calls with a different BlockList constant; list screen is a plain table.

name: Archive a poster's stories (move between main and archive list)
uiSurface: long-press menu on a tray avatar plus an Archived Stories screen
rationale: Single call; the archive screen is the same tray/list view fed by storyListArchive.

name: My stories archive (all my expired stories)
uiSurface: grid or plain list of thumbnails on a My Stories screen in Settings
rationale: No UICollectionView on iOS 6, so a thumbnail grid must be hand-laid out in a scroll view.

name: Stories saved to profile page
uiSurface: a Stories section on the user/channel profile screen plus a Save-to-Profile toggle in the viewer sheet
rationale: Toggle is trivial but rendering a stories grid inside the profile screen is new layout work.

name: Pinned stories on profile
uiSurface: multi-select mode over the profile stories grid
rationale: Requires selection UI over the grid from the previous entry.

name: Story viewers list (interactions)
uiSurface: bottom sheet or pushed table of avatars with reaction badges, opened from the eye-count in the viewer footer
rationale: Paged table with search and filters; needs the viewer footer to exist first, but the table itself is conventional.

name: Story view/forward/reaction counters
uiSurface: eye icon plus counts in the viewer footer for own stories
rationale: Pure display of fields already present on the story object.

name: Stealth mode
uiSurface: action-sheet item in the viewer with a cooldown countdown label
rationale: Premium-only server side; the call exists but returns an error without a subscription.

name: Custom story expiration period
uiSurface: picker row in the composer (6h / 12h / 24h / 48h)
rationale: active_period other than 86400 requires Premium; keep the composer hard-coded to 24h.

name: Report a story
uiSurface: action sheet leading into the same multi-step report option list we need for messages
rationale: Identical shape to the message report flow: option list table plus a text field.

name: Story notification settings (mute stories per chat / scope)
uiSurface: toggles in the chat notifications screen and a global Stories section in Notification settings
rationale: Extra boolean fields on notification-settings calls plus switch rows.

name: Story reaction notifications
uiSurface: segmented row (All / Contacts / None) in Notification settings
rationale: One setter with an enum; a three-row radio group.

name: Story albums (create, rename, reorder, delete)
uiSurface: tabs or a segmented header over the profile stories grid plus an editable album list
rationale: New navigation layer on top of the profile stories grid; the individual calls are trivial once the grid exists.

name: Story album contents management
uiSurface: multi-select over the archive grid with an Add to Album action sheet
rationale: Depends on the grid and selection mode.

name: Story interactive areas (location, venue, link, message, weather, gift, suggested reaction)
uiSurface: tappable overlay rectangles positioned by percentage over the story image in the viewer
rationale: Read-only rendering plus hit testing is doable with frame math; authoring areas (drag/rotate stickers) should stay out of scope.

name: Search public stories by tag / location / venue
uiSurface: results grid reached by tapping a hashtag or a location area
rationale: Needs the thumbnail grid and paging by next_offset.

name: Story deep links
uiSurface: no UI; URL handling that resolves a username plus story id and opens the viewer
rationale: One resolve call then push the viewer, assuming the viewer exists.

name: Can-post gating and limit feedback
uiSurface: alert text shown before opening the composer
rationale: Single call mapped to a UIAlertView message.

name: Choosing which chat to post as
uiSurface: chat picker row at the top of the composer
rationale: Returns a Chats vector we already know how to render as a list.

name: Channel story admin rights
uiSurface: three extra switch rows on the admin-rights screen
rationale: Additional booleans in an existing settings payload.

name: Story statistics
uiSurface: graph screen reached from the viewer for channel stories
rationale: Returns StatisticalGraph JSON meant for a charting webview; no WKWebView on iOS 6 and no charting stack here.

name: Business account stories (edit/delete via bot connection)
uiSurface: none of our own
rationale: Requires a business connection and a connected bot; irrelevant to a personal legacy client.

name: Story auto-download preloading
uiSurface: switch row in Data and Storage settings
rationale: One boolean in an existing settings struct; should default to off given 512MB.

name: Story file types in storage cleanup
uiSurface: existing Storage Usage screen; add story file types to the clear list
rationale: optimizeStorage is already wrapped in TGClient.m; only the file_types vector needs the two story constants.

name: Global message search
uiSurface: results section in the existing dedicated search page (TGSearchViewController)
rationale: TGClient -searchMessages:completion: already exists and the search screen already renders results; only paging via next_offset is missing.

name: Global search paging (load more)
uiSurface: infinite-scroll footer cell on the search results table
rationale: Needs one extra wrapper that passes the offset string returned by foundMessages; UI is a load-more row.

name: In-chat message search
uiSurface: search bar over the conversation with prev/next result navigation bar at the bottom
rationale: The call is wrapped but the in-conversation search chrome (jump-to-result, up/down arrows, result counter) is new UI and needs message-scroll plumbing.

name: In-chat search by sender
uiSurface: 'from:' sender picker chip inside the in-chat search bar
rationale: Requires a member picker feeding sender_id into the search, on top of the not-yet-built in-chat search UI.

name: Filtered global search by media type
uiSurface: segmented scope bar above the search results table
rationale: Same wrapper with a filter type string; UISegmentedControl as table header works on iOS 6.

name: Search scoped to private/group/channel
uiSurface: extra options in the same scope bar / action sheet
rationale: One more optional parameter on the same search call.

name: Search by date range
uiSurface: date range action sheet with UIDatePicker
rationale: min_date/max_date are trivial to pass, but a usable date-range picker is real new UI.

name: Local chat list search (chats by title)
uiSurface: 'Chats' section at the top of the search results table
rationale: Returns Chats; renders with the existing chat cell used in the chat list.

name: Public chat / username search
uiSurface: 'Global search' section below local results, same chat cell
rationale: searchPublicChat is already wrapped; searchPublicChats is a one-method addition returning the same Chats shape.

name: Contact search
uiSurface: search bar on the contacts screen and a Contacts section on the search page
rationale: Returns Users; rows identical to the existing contacts list.

name: Search user by phone number
uiSurface: implicit: phone-shaped query yields a single user row
rationale: Already wrapped; just needs a query-looks-like-a-phone branch in the search controller.

name: Chat member search
uiSurface: search bar over the group members list; also feeds mention autocomplete
rationale: Single call, plain user rows in an existing members table.

name: Recent searches (recently found chats)
uiSurface: 'Recent' section shown on the empty search page with a Clear button and swipe-to-delete
rationale: Four tiny wrappers; the empty-state section is a normal table section, and this is what the 2013 design shows on entering search.

name: Top / frequently contacted peers
uiSurface: horizontal avatar strip or a 'People' section on the empty search page
rationale: The call is trivial but the period-correct horizontal avatar rail is custom scroll-view layout (no UICollectionView on iOS 6).

name: Recently opened chats
uiSurface: alternative empty-state section on the search page
rationale: One call returning Chats, rendered with the existing chat cell.

name: Hashtag prefix autocomplete
uiSurface: autocomplete strip above the keyboard in the composer, plus suggestions in the search field
rationale: Call is trivial but the inline autocomplete overlay above the input bar is new plumbing shared with mention/emoji completion.

name: Public hashtag/cashtag post search
uiSurface: results list opened by tapping a #hashtag in a message
rationale: Reuses the global-search result list; needs the tap handler on hashtag entities plus one wrapper.

name: Searched-for tag history
uiSurface: recent-hashtags rows on the empty hashtag search state
rationale: Three one-line wrappers feeding a plain table section.

name: Saved Messages tag search (filter saved messages by reaction tag)
uiSurface: horizontal tag chip bar pinned under the nav bar in Saved Messages
rationale: Needs a custom chip rail, custom-emoji tag rendering and saved-messages-topic plumbing; also tag labels are a premium-gated edit though reading/filtering is not.

name: Saved Messages topics list and pinning
uiSurface: a topic list screen inside Saved Messages
rationale: An entirely new list screen with its own update handling, not just a search surface.

name: Shared media search inside a chat
uiSurface: tabs on the existing shared-media screen with a search field
rationale: TGClient -mediaInChat:filter: already takes a filter string; adding a query field is a small change.

name: Jump to date in history (calendar)
uiSurface: month-grid calendar modal reachable from in-chat search
rationale: getChatMessageByDate alone is trivial, but the calendar heat-grid is a hand-drawn view; a cut-down UIDatePicker jump is the cheap fallback.

name: Media grid scrollbar date positions
uiSurface: fast-scroll date bubble on the shared media grid
rationale: Needs a custom fast-scroller overlay; low value on a 4S-sized screen but technically possible.

name: Call log search / missed calls filter
uiSurface: 'Missed' segmented filter on a recent-calls list
rationale: One call returning FoundMessages of call messages; rows are simple.

name: Secret chat search
uiSurface: same in-chat search bar, used when the chat is secret
rationale: Secret chats need active local E2E sessions and per-device key handling that this client does not implement, so the search has nothing to search.

name: Downloaded files search
uiSurface: 'Downloads' section on the search page
rationale: Depends on a download-manager UI we do not have; the search call alone is meaningless without it.

name: Outgoing document search (for re-sharing files)
uiSurface: file picker sheet in the attachment menu
rationale: One call, results shown as plain file rows in an existing-style table.

name: Sticker / sticker set / emoji search
uiSurface: search field on the sticker panel and the sticker-set settings list
rationale: Sticker panel search needs a scrollable sticker grid without UICollectionView plus animated-sticker handling that is heavy on a 4S.

name: Public post search (paid global post search)
uiSurface: extra scope on the global search page
rationale: Requires spending Telegram Stars (star_count) per query, i.e. a paid balance and payments stack we cannot reach.

name: Story search by tag / location / venue
uiSurface: story grid viewer
rationale: Stories require a full-screen video story viewer and mostly H.264 story playback/upload that a 512MB single-core 4S cannot sustain; no story UI exists at all.

name: Sponsored chat search results
uiSurface: promoted row at the top of global search results
rationale: Ad surface with view/click reporting obligations; no user value in a legacy client and best left out.

name: Live location message search in a chat
uiSurface: 'live locations' banner and list in a chat
rationale: Call is simple but it only makes sense with a live-location map view, which is separate work.

name: Nearby / location-based public chat discovery
uiSurface: 'People nearby' list
rationale: The dedicated searchChatsNearby method was removed from the schema and the server feature was discontinued.

name: Username availability check
uiSurface: inline validity label under the username text field in settings/group edit
rationale: One call, one colored status label; classic 2013 pattern.

name: Quote position search (locating a quoted fragment)
uiSurface: none directly; supports reply-with-quote highlighting
rationale: Only useful once reply quotes exist; belongs with the reply UI work, not search.

name: Prefix search over local strings (country picker, language list)
uiSurface: search bar over the country-code and language pickers
rationale: Single synchronous-style call driving an existing filtered table.

name: Premium status badge for users
uiSurface: Small star badge next to the name in chat list rows, chat header title and profile screen header
rationale: is_premium is already present in the user object TGClient parses; drawing a static badge glyph is pure UI.

name: Premium limits inspector (default vs boosted values)
uiSurface: A grouped table in Settings > Telegram Premium listing each limit as 'default N / premium M' rows
rationale: One request per limit type returning two ints; renders as plain right-detail table rows.

name: Enforce the correct client-side limits for the current account
uiSurface: No screen of its own; caption/bio/message length counters, pinned-chat cap, folder cap in existing editors
rationale: We already have bio and caption editors; wiring their max length to the fetched premiumLimit is a few lines each.

name: Premium feature list / promo screen
uiSurface: A dedicated 'Telegram Premium' screen reachable from Settings, one row per feature with icon and subtitle
rationale: Needs a whole new screen and a period-appropriate icon set per feature; the promo animations are MP4/animated and must be skipped or replaced by static art.

name: Current premium state and subscription info
uiSurface: Header block on the Premium settings screen: active/inactive, expiry date, price options as read-only rows
rationale: TGClient already sends getPremiumState; only the formattedText state and option list need rendering as text rows.

name: Buying a Premium subscription in-app
uiSurface: Purchase button plus StoreKit product sheet
rationale: Requires the official Telegram App Store product IDs bound to their bundle ID; our sideloaded bundle cannot fetch or transact those SKProducts, and TDLib will reject a receipt from a foreign bundle.

name: Buying Premium via the payment link (web checkout)
uiSurface: Row that opens the invoice in Safari or an in-app UIWebView
rationale: The Telegram invoice checkout flow is a modern web/native payment form; iOS 6 UIWebView plus no card-entry UI on our side makes a real purchase unreachable, and TDLib's native form needs card tokenization we cannot implement safely.

name: Redeem a Premium gift code
uiSurface: Action sheet from a t.me/giftcode link or a 'Redeem code' row with a text field in Settings
rationale: Two simple calls; the info screen is a few labels (from whom, months, used or not) plus one Apply button.

name: Gift code / giveaway deep link handling
uiSurface: URL handler routing t.me links into the redeem or boost sheet
rationale: We need a general internal-link router in the client first; the routing table itself is plumbing, not a single call.

name: Gift Premium to a user with Stars
uiSurface: 'Gift Premium' row on a user profile opening a duration picker sheet (3/6/12 months) with star prices
rationale: Doable with a real star balance, but needs a new picker screen and gift-sticker art; without stars in the account it fails at the server, so it is only useful for accounts with a balance.

name: Gift Premium via App Store purchase
uiSurface: Purchase sheet
rationale: Same App Store product-ID problem as buying a subscription; the alternate telegramPaymentPurpose path needs a card payment form we cannot build on iOS 6.

name: View giveaway message and its results
uiSurface: A custom message bubble in the chat: prize sticker, 'N x Premium for M months', participating channels, winners date
rationale: A genuinely new bubble layout with multiple stacked sections; currently these render as unsupported messages.

name: Giveaway participation status / 'How it works' sheet
uiSurface: Action sheet or modal with explanatory text and one action button, launched by tapping the giveaway bubble
rationale: One request returning a status enum; the whole UI is a text blob plus an OK button, once the bubble exists to tap.

name: Creating a giveaway in a channel
uiSurface: Multi-step composer: winner count, duration, country filter, additional channels, date picker
rationale: Creation is fundamentally a purchase, and every purchase path (App Store product IDs, card form) is unreachable for us; the multi-step composer would be dead UI.

name: Launch a prepaid giveaway the channel already owns
uiSurface: Row in channel boost screen listing prepaid giveaways, opening a parameters form (date, only-new-members, countries)
rationale: No payment involved so it is technically reachable, but it needs a real parameters form and a date picker, and only applies to channels that already bought a giveaway.

name: Channel boost status and level
uiSurface: 'Boosts' section on the channel profile: current level, boost count, progress to next level, copy-link row
rationale: One call returning plain integers; a level label, a simple progress bar drawn with two UIViews and a copy-link action sheet.

name: Boost a channel with your own slots
uiSurface: 'Boost this channel' button plus a slot-reassignment action sheet when all slots are used
rationale: The call is one line, but the slot-reassignment case needs a list of currently boosted chats with cooldown dates, which is a real new sheet; also only meaningful for a premium account.

name: Who boosted this channel
uiSurface: Paged user list on the channel boost screen, one avatar row per booster with expiry subtitle
rationale: A paginated list request mapped onto the user-row cell we already have for members.

name: Boost level feature table
uiSurface: 'What boosts unlock' table, one section per level
rationale: Static data returned in one call, rendered as grouped rows of booleans and counts.

name: Star balance and transaction history
uiSurface: 'Stars' row in Settings opening a balance header plus a paged transaction list
rationale: The list itself is simple rows, but StarTransactionType has ~50 variants each needing its own title and icon, so it is a real mapping and layout job.

name: Star subscriptions management
uiSurface: Table of active subscriptions with chat title, period and price; tap opens a sheet with Cancel / Renew
rationale: One list call plus two one-argument mutations; entirely rows and an action sheet.

name: Buying Stars
uiSurface: Star package grid
rationale: In-app purchase against Telegram's own App Store products, impossible from our bundle; the card-payment alternative is equally out of reach.

name: Star revenue and withdrawal for owned channels
uiSurface: Revenue block on channel admin screen with a graph and a withdraw button
rationale: Needs 2FA password entry then an external web withdrawal page; the statistical graph is a modern chart format with no renderer available to us, and the flow ends in a browser we cannot secure.

name: Received gifts on a profile
uiSurface: 'Gifts' section on the profile showing gift stickers in a grid, tap opens a detail sheet with Save/Hide and Convert to Stars
rationale: getReceivedGifts is already wrapped, but the gift grid and the detail sheet are new layout work and the gift art is animated TGS we must render as a static thumbnail.

name: Sending a star gift
uiSurface: 'Send a gift' entry on a profile opening a gift catalogue grid with prices, then a message-and-privacy sheet
rationale: Reachable only with an existing star balance, and needs a catalogue grid plus a compose sheet; without UICollectionView the grid must be hand-laid-out.

name: Upgraded (unique) gifts and their attributes
uiSurface: Gradient-backdrop gift card with rotating pattern, rarity percentages, transfer and resale actions
rationale: The entire visual identity is animated custom-emoji models, symbol patterns and gradient backdrops rendered per-frame; a 4S with no lottie renderer and 512MB cannot present these, and every action costs stars we do not have.

name: Emoji status (premium and gift-based)
uiSurface: Status picker sheet from the profile header, and a small status glyph next to names
rationale: Statuses are custom emoji identified only by a document id that must be downloaded and animated; we have no custom-emoji rendering pipeline, so the picker would show empty cells.

name: Premium stickers and premium sticker examples
uiSurface: A section in the sticker panel
rationale: The whole point is the premium animation overlay, which is a TGS/webm effect we cannot play; showing the static sticker adds nothing over the normal packs.

name: Premium info sticker for gift/promo headers
uiSurface: Header image on the Premium or gift screens
rationale: Single call returning a sticker file; download and show the static thumbnail as a header image.

name: Voice-to-text recognition (premium-gated)
uiSurface: A small 'A' button on voice note bubbles expanding to show transcribed text
rationale: Server does the work so it is technically possible, but the bubble must grow to hold a transcript and handle the pending/failed states, and it only works on a premium account.

name: Premium-gated upload size and download speed options
uiSurface: Informational rows on the Premium screen; also gates the max file size in the attach flow
rationale: getOption is already wrapped in TGClient; these are integer reads shown as labels.

name: Premium-only privacy toggles (last seen, message privacy, read receipts)
uiSurface: Extra rows in the existing Privacy settings screen, disabled with a premium hint when not subscribed
rationale: setUserPrivacySettingRules is already wrapped; these are additional switch rows on a screen we already have.

name: Business features catalogue
uiSurface: 'Telegram Business' list of feature rows under the Premium screen
rationale: Listing them is trivial, but each feature behind the row is its own editor screen (hours, away messages, chat links), which is substantial new plumbing.

name: Ad-free experience / sponsored message removal
uiSurface: None; simply not rendering sponsored messages
rationale: We never implemented sponsored messages, so we are already ad-free; at most this is a claim on the Premium screen.

name: Gift auctions and crafting
uiSurface: Live auction screen with countdown and bid feed
rationale: Real-time bidding UI on top of animated unique-gift art, requiring a large star balance; nothing about it is reachable on this device or this account.

name: Star balance display
uiSurface: A value label on a Settings row and a header label on the Stars screen; fed by a cached balance property on TGClient
rationale: updateOwnedStarCount arrives as a plain update; storing star_count/nanostar_count and showing it in a settings detail label is one method plus one row.

name: Star transaction history
uiSurface: New pushed table screen with balance header, paged rows (title, date, +/- star amount), and an incoming/outgoing segmented filter
rationale: Needs a new screen with offset paging plus per-row rendering of ~30 StarTransactionType variants each with a different title/avatar, which is real layout work, not a row.

name: Star transaction detail sheet
uiSurface: Modal detail view over the transactions list showing product photo, peer, transaction id and amount
rationale: Requires a bespoke card-style modal with photo download and copyable transaction id.

name: Buying Stars via in-app purchase
uiSurface: Star package picker list
rationale: Requires StoreKit products registered to Telegram's App Store account; a sideloaded legacy build has no valid product identifiers and cannot complete an Apple IAP, and the alternate Fragment/web top-up path needs a modern browser session.

name: Gifting Stars to a user
uiSurface: Profile action row plus package picker
rationale: Same StoreKit dependency as buying Stars; only the incoming messageGiftedStars service message can be rendered.

name: Bot invoice message rendering
uiSurface: Chat bubble showing product title, description, photo and a Pay button; already summarised as text in TGClient message preview
rationale: TGClient.m already stringifies messageInvoice for chat-list previews, but an actual invoice bubble with photo and pay button is new bubble layout in TGChatViewController.

name: Payment form for Stars-priced invoices
uiSurface: Confirmation sheet: product info, star price, Confirm button, then success toast
rationale: Star payments need no card credentials at all, so the flow is getPaymentForm plus sendPaymentForm with empty credentials, but it still needs a new confirmation sheet and error handling for insufficient balance.

name: Card payment form (regular provider)
uiSurface: Multi-step checkout: card entry form, shipping address form, shipping option picker, tip picker, final confirm screen
rationale: Technically reachable on iOS 6 (UIWebView covers paymentProviderOther and Stripe tokenization is a plain HTTPS POST), but it is the largest UI surface in this area: several form screens plus card validation and native-vs-web branching.

name: Saved payment credentials
uiSurface: Saved-card row inside the checkout screen plus a 'Clear saved payment info' destructive row in Settings/Privacy
rationale: deleteSavedCredentials is a no-argument call behind a confirmation action sheet; selecting a saved card is one table row in the checkout screen.

name: Apple Pay checkout
uiSurface: Apple Pay button on the checkout screen
rationale: PassKit payment requests require iOS 8 and Secure Element hardware the iPhone 4S lacks.

name: Payment receipt view
uiSurface: Read-only receipt screen reached by tapping the 'payment successful' service message
rationale: Needs a new screen listing price parts, tip, shipping and charge ids; the service message tap target is also new.

name: Star gift catalogue and sending a gift
uiSurface: Gift picker grid opened from a profile, with a message field, anonymity toggle and confirm; plus 'who can gift me' toggles in Settings
rationale: The calls are simple but the picker is a grid of animated sticker gifts with prices, which means new layout without UICollectionView and downscaled sticker rendering for 512MB.

name: Received gifts on a profile
uiSurface: Gifts section on TGProfileViewController: list rows with sticker, sender and star value; long-press actions for hide/pin/convert-to-stars
rationale: TGClient.m already wraps getReceivedGifts and returns title/starCount, so adding the display rows and one-call toggleGiftIsSaved/sellGift actions behind an action sheet is small.

name: Gift notifications for channels
uiSurface: Single switch row in a channel's gift section
rationale: One boolean call behind a UISwitch.

name: Unique gift upgrade
uiSurface: Upgrade preview sheet that cycles model/symbol/backdrop, plus a full unique-gift detail card with gradient backdrop and attribute rows
rationale: The upgraded-gift card is an entirely bespoke visual (radial gradient backdrop, pattern symbols, rarity percentages) and the preview animates through variants.

name: Gift transfer and original-details drop
uiSurface: Action sheet on a unique gift plus a recipient picker reusing TGForwardPicker
rationale: Both are single calls with a star cost confirmation; the recipient picker already exists as TGForwardPicker.

name: Gift resale marketplace
uiSurface: Browsable marketplace grid with model/symbol/backdrop attribute filters and a price-setting sheet
rationale: A filtered paged marketplace with three attribute facet pickers is a substantial new screen stack.

name: Gift collections
uiSurface: Tab strip above the profile gifts list plus an edit screen with rename/delete rows
rationale: All eight calls are flat parameter passes and the UI is a segmented strip plus an editable table with standard table reordering.

name: Gift crafting
uiSurface: Multi-select gift picker showing per-attribute persistence probabilities and a result reveal
rationale: Needs a multi-select picker plus a probability display and an outcome animation; no existing screen resembles it.

name: Gift auctions
uiSurface: Live auction screen with countdown, round position and bid entry
rationale: Real-time state driven by updates with a countdown and live bid list; the TDLib side is straightforward but the screen is entirely new and timing-sensitive.

name: Paid message reactions (star reactions)
uiSurface: Star reaction button on channel post bubbles with an undo window; our TGSnackbar already provides the undo banner
rationale: The pending/commit/undo lifecycle plus a star-count picker overlay on the bubble is genuine chat-view plumbing, though TGSnackbar covers the undo affordance.

name: Paid media (locked media purchase)
uiSurface: Blurred minithumbnail bubble with a 'Unlock for N stars' button, unlocking into the normal media bubble
rationale: TGClient.m already recognises messagePaidMedia for previews, but the blurred-cover bubble and unlock-then-reload path is new chat rendering.

name: Paid messages (charge per incoming DM)
uiSurface: A star-price row in Privacy settings, an 'allow free messages' row on a profile, and a confirm-cost alert before sending into a paid chat
rationale: Setters are single calls; the send-side cost confirmation is a TGAlertView and a paid_message_star_count parameter already present on the send functions.

name: Star subscriptions management
uiSurface: Subscriptions list screen with per-row cancel/renew action sheet
rationale: A new paged list, though each row's action is a one-line call; grouping it under the Stars screen makes it a moderate second tab rather than a row.

name: Star revenue statistics and withdrawal
uiSurface: Revenue screen with balance rows and a withdraw button that opens a URL
rationale: Withdrawal requires the 2FA password check plus an external Fragment web session; the returned URL cannot be completed inside a UIWebView on iOS 6 and only applies to bot/channel owners.

name: Star payment refunds
uiSurface: Refund row on a star transaction detail sheet
rationale: Single call with user_id and charge id, only meaningful for bot owners, but trivial to expose.

name: Premium gift codes
uiSurface: Gift-code link handler showing an info alert with an Apply button
rationale: Two calls and an alert; the code arrives from a t.me link tap.

name: Gifting Premium with Stars
uiSurface: Duration picker sheet from a profile with a star price per option
rationale: Reachable without StoreKit because it is paid in Stars, but needs a new picker sheet and a message field.

name: Star and Premium giveaways
uiSurface: Giveaway creation wizard (channels, winner count, duration) and giveaway result bubbles
rationale: Creating a giveaway needs the App Store purchase path we cannot use; only launchPrepaidGiveaway would work and it requires an already-prepaid boost, so the feature is not usable end to end here.

name: Creating invoice links (bot/business side)
uiSurface: None on a user client
rationale: These are bot-account APIs; a user session cannot call them meaningfully.

name: Business account star balance and gift settings
uiSurface: Rows inside a business-connection screen we do not have
rationale: Requires an active business connection granted to a bot; no path to it from this client.

name: Open Saved Messages chat
uiSurface: Row in chat list plus a Saved Messages entry in the main menu/settings; opens the existing chat screen
rationale: TGClient already exposes savedMessagesChatId and renames the self-chat to Saved Messages; only an explicit entry point is missing.

name: Save (forward) messages to Saved Messages
uiSurface: Action-sheet item on message long-press: 'Save to Saved Messages', targeting savedMessagesChatId
rationale: forwardMessages: is already wrapped; this is one extra action-sheet row with a fixed destination chat id.

name: Saved Messages topics list (chats-inside-Saved-Messages)
uiSurface: A whole new chat-list-like screen that Saved Messages opens into, with avatar+title+last-message rows per origin author
rationale: Needs a new list controller, incremental update handling from two update types, and topic-type-to-title/avatar resolution; it changes what tapping Saved Messages does.

name: Saved Messages topic history (per-author message stream)
uiSurface: Reuses the chat screen but paginates through a topic id instead of chat history
rationale: Existing chat controller is hardwired to getChatHistory/searchChatMessages; needs a parallel loading path keyed by saved_messages_topic_id.

name: Pin / unpin Saved Messages topics and reorder pins
uiSurface: Swipe action or long-press sheet on a topic row in the topics list; reorder via table edit mode
rationale: The calls are one-liners but they only exist once the topics list screen exists, and reordering needs edit-mode plumbing.

name: Delete a Saved Messages topic / clear its history
uiSurface: Destructive row in the topic long-press action sheet with a confirm sheet
rationale: Single request plus a UIActionSheet confirmation once a topic id is in hand; wrapping is one TGClient method.

name: Saved Messages tags: list and display
uiSurface: Horizontal tag chip strip pinned under the nav bar in Saved Messages, plus a small tag badge on message bubbles
rationale: New horizontal chip control and per-message badge rendering; emoji tags render as text so no custom-emoji animation is needed.

name: Tag a saved message (add/remove tag reaction)
uiSurface: 'Tag' item on message long-press opening an emoji picker sheet
rationale: addMessageReaction is wrapped, but tagging needs an emoji chooser sheet and awareness that in Saved Messages a reaction is a tag, not a reaction.

name: Rename a tag (set tag label)
uiSurface: Long-press a tag chip -> UIAlertView with a text field on iOS 6
rationale: One request plus a UIAlertView text-field prompt; UIAlertController is unavailable so use the legacy alert style.

name: Filter Saved Messages by tag / search within saved
uiSurface: Tapping a tag chip filters the stream; the existing search bar feeds the query argument
rationale: Requires a filtered message-list mode in the chat screen driven by FoundChatMessages paging rather than normal history.

name: Custom-emoji tags
uiSurface: Custom emoji entries inside the tag picker and chips
rationale: Custom emoji tags require Telegram Premium to set and animated-sticker (TGS/lottie) rendering that a single-core A5 with 512MB cannot afford; plain emoji tags cover the feature.

name: Premium pinned-topic limit raise and premium tag features
uiSurface: None beyond an error toast when the limit is hit
rationale: Depends on an active Premium subscription server-side; the client can only surface the limit error.

name: Per-topic draft messages
uiSurface: Compose bar text restored when reopening a topic; draft preview text on the topic row
rationale: Needs the MessageTopic argument threaded through the draft path and a per-topic draft cache.

name: tg://saved deep link handling
uiSurface: No UI: URL handler routes to the Saved Messages screen
rationale: One extra case in link-type dispatch that pushes the Saved Messages chat.

name: Date jump / sparse scroll positions inside Saved Messages
uiSurface: Fast-scroll date bubble or a 'jump to date' picker
rationale: Needs a scrubber UI and position-index bookkeeping; useful but not a simple row.

name: Pin a message inside Saved Messages
uiSurface: Pinned-message banner at the top of the chat screen plus a long-press action
rationale: Message pinning applies to the self-chat like any chat but needs the pinned banner component; note pinning is per-chat, not per saved topic.

name: Pin the Saved Messages chat in the chat list
uiSurface: Existing chat-list swipe/long-press pin action
rationale: Already wrapped and works on the self-chat without any change.

name: Inline keyboard rendering under messages
uiSurface: a button grid laid out under the bubble in ChatViewCell, sized into the cell height
rationale: message.reply_markup already arrives in every message dict but ChatViewCell has no button-row layout, hit testing or height contribution, so it is real new UI plus cell-metrics plumbing.

name: Callback button press (get answer, show alert/toast, open URL)
uiSurface: tap handler on an inline button, result shown via TGAlertView or TGSnackbar, url opened with UIApplication openURL
rationale: One request:completion: call and an existing alert/snackbar surface, once the keyboard from the previous entry exists.

name: Callback with password (2FA-protected buttons)
uiSurface: password prompt alert before re-issuing the callback
rationale: Rare path, but it is a TGAlertView with a secure text field plus the same call.

name: Custom reply keyboard (show/hide, resize, one-time, persistent)
uiSurface: a keyboard-substitute panel above the input bar in TGChatViewController plus a toggle button in the input accessory
rationale: Needs a whole new input-bar mode with its own panel, keyboard swapping and force-reply focus behaviour.

name: Reply keyboard special buttons: share phone / share location / create poll
uiSurface: confirmation action sheet, then reuse existing contact/location/poll send paths
rationale: TGActionSheet plus sendContactNamed:/sendLocation: already exist; poll creation UI already shipped.

name: Request users / request chat buttons
uiSurface: a filtered picker built on TGForwardPicker / TGContactsViewController, then the share call
rationale: The filter criteria (bot/premium/admin-rights/forum) need a new multi-select picker with restriction filtering, not just an existing list.

name: Bot command list and slash-command autocomplete
uiSurface: a dropdown list above the input bar when the text starts with '/', and a slash button in the input bar
rationale: Commands come free inside userFullInfo.bot_info, but the autocomplete overlay panel and its filtering are new UI.

name: Start a bot / deep-link start parameter
uiSurface: a full-width START button replacing the input bar in an empty bot chat
rationale: Single call; the button is one view swapped into the existing input-bar slot.

name: Bot profile header: description, short description, about
uiSurface: extra rows in TGProfileViewController for bot users
rationale: Data is already in userFullInfo; it is a label row on an existing screen.

name: Inline query results (@bot query in the input bar)
uiSurface: a results panel above the input bar (list for articles, grid for media) with paging on next_offset
rationale: Whole new overlay panel with two layout modes, thumbnail loading and pagination; the send call itself is trivial but the browser is not.

name: Inline results switch-pm button (Switch to private chat)
uiSurface: a header row on top of the inline results panel
rationale: One row in the panel above, once that panel exists.

name: Recently used inline bots
uiSurface: suggestion rows shown when the user types a bare '@' in the input bar
rationale: Plain user list feeding the existing mention-autocomplete style row.

name: switchInline inline-keyboard button (query hand-off to another chat)
uiSurface: prefills the input bar, or opens TGForwardPicker to choose a target chat first
rationale: Chat picker already exists; the action is just setting input text in the target chat.

name: Bot menu button (the button left of the input bar)
uiSurface: a small labelled button in the input bar of a bot chat that opens a web app or the command list
rationale: New input-bar element with a text-width-driven animated slot, and its payload is usually a web app which we cannot open (see below).

name: Web apps (openWebApp / bot mini apps)
uiSurface: a full-screen web container with a Telegram JS bridge
rationale: Mini apps require WKWebView-class JS bridging, modern TLS and ES6; iOS 6 UIWebView cannot run current Telegram Web App JS, and the 512MB 4S would not survive a modern SPA anyway.

name: Attachment menu bots
uiSurface: extra icons in the attachment action sheet
rationale: Every attachment-menu bot entry point launches a web app, which is blocked; the icons alone would be dead buttons.

name: Bot write-access permission (Allow bot to message you)
uiSurface: a confirmation action sheet, usually triggered from a bot start or link
rationale: Two plain calls and a TGActionSheet.

name: Bot service messages (write access allowed, users shared, chat shared, bot refunded)
uiSurface: centered grey service-text line in ChatViewCell
rationale: The service-message rendering path already exists; these are extra @type cases mapping to a string.

name: Message-is-from-inline-bot attribution (via @bot)
uiSurface: a 'via @bot' suffix in the message header line
rationale: One extra label segment in the existing bubble header.

name: Games (play, high scores)
uiSurface: game message bubble with title/photo, a Play button, and a high-score table
rationale: The game bubble itself is drawable (messageGame is already recognised in TGClient), but playing requires loading an HTML5 game URL in a modern web view; only a static, non-playable card plus the high-score list is achievable, so treat playing as blocked.

name: Bot similar bots suggestions
uiSurface: a 'Similar bots' section on the bot profile screen
rationale: Plain user list into an existing profile section; premium gating only limits how many are returned, not access.

name: Bot verification badge on senders
uiSurface: small custom-emoji badge next to a name in profile/chat header
rationale: The badge icon is a custom emoji sticker that must be downloaded, downscaled and cached inline in a text line, which is new plumbing.

name: Inline message editing (editing messages sent via inline bots)
uiSurface: none of ours; only relevant if we act as a bot
rationale: These require a bot token session (checkAuthenticationBotToken); a user client can never call them.

name: Bot management console (create/rename bots, tokens, media previews, usernames)
