uiSurface: a whole bot-owner settings stack under Settings
rationale: Technically all reachable from a user session that owns bots, but it is a multi-screen settings hierarchy with photo upload and media-preview editing; low value for this client.

name: Business connected bot management
uiSurface: Telegram Business settings section
rationale: Telegram Business features require an active Premium/Business subscription on the account; unusable for the target user.

name: Prepared inline messages and prepared keyboard buttons
uiSurface: a share sheet invoked by a mini app
rationale: Only ever triggered from inside a running Web App, which we cannot host.

name: Grossing web app bots / web app placeholder / guard bot url
uiSurface: none reachable without a web app container
rationale: All are support calls for the mini-app runtime that iOS 6 cannot provide.

name: Per-scope notification on/off (private / groups / channels)
uiSurface: three switch rows on the existing Notifications settings page (already built in TGSettingsViewController.m)
rationale: Fully wrapped by -notificationsMutedForScope:completion: / -setScope:muted: and already shipping; only refinement left.

name: Message preview toggle per scope
uiSurface: one extra switch row per scope section, 'Message Preview', on the Notifications page
rationale: show_preview is already a field in the dict TGClient writes; needs the setter to read current settings first instead of hardcoding YES.

name: Pinned-message and mention notification suppression per scope
uiSurface: two switch rows under each group/channel scope section
rationale: disable_pinned_message_notifications / disable_mention_notifications are plain booleans on the same scope struct.

name: Live scope-settings sync from other devices
uiSurface: no new UI: refresh the toggles on the Notifications page when the update arrives
rationale: One extra branch in the TGClient update dispatcher plus an NSNotification, same shape as the existing updateChatNotificationSettings branch.

name: Mute / unmute a single chat
uiSurface: chat list swipe/long-press action sheet and the profile screen's Notifications row
rationale: -setChat:muted: exists and updateChatNotificationSettings is already parsed into the isMuted flag on chat info.

name: Mute a chat for a chosen duration (1 hour / 8 hours / 2 days / forever)
uiSurface: TGActionSheet with four duration options, launched from the profile Notifications row
rationale: Just a different mute_for value through the existing setter; TGActionSheet already exists.

name: Per-chat override of preview / sound / mentions (use_default_* flags)
uiSurface: a dedicated per-chat 'Notifications' sub-page: toggles plus a 'Default' reset row
rationale: Every field is paired with a use_default_ flag, so the screen needs tri-state rows (default / on / off) and a read of the chat's current settings, which TGClient does not surface today.

name: Notification exceptions list (chats that differ from the scope default)
uiSurface: 'Exceptions' row per scope opening a chat list with per-row muted/unmuted subtitle, plus 'Delete All Exceptions'
rationale: Returns a Chats vector we must resolve to chat rows and render with per-chat state; new list controller and new client plumbing.

name: Reset all notification settings
uiSurface: a destructive red row at the bottom of the Notifications page with a confirm TGAlertView
rationale: Single argumentless call; UI is one row and one alert.

name: Per-chat default 'send silently' flag
uiSurface: toggle row on the chat's notification sub-page; optionally a bell icon in the compose bar
rationale: One boolean call plus one update branch.

name: Send a single message silently
uiSurface: long-press on the send button showing a 'Send without sound' action sheet
rationale: Requires threading a messageSendOptions dict through the existing send paths, which currently pass no options, plus a new send-button gesture.

name: Reaction and poll-vote notification settings
uiSurface: a 'Reactions' section with two picker rows (Everyone / Contacts / Off) and a preview toggle
rationale: Three enum values and two booleans; the picker is an action sheet, no new layout.

name: Story notification settings and story exceptions
uiSurface: a Stories section on the Notifications page and a story exceptions list
rationale: The client has no stories feature at all; story notification settings are meaningless without the story surface, and stories themselves are out of scope on a 4S.

name: Custom notification sound picker (saved/uploaded sounds)
uiSurface: a 'Sound' row opening a list of sounds with a checkmark and tap-to-preview
rationale: The list and sound_id assignment are doable, but server sounds are MP3/OGG while iOS local notifications only play a bundled CAF under 30s, so previewing works in-app whereas actually using the sound for an alert requires transcoding and bundling; treat as design, not trivial.

name: APNs push registration (device token upload)
uiSurface: none, AppDelegate only
rationale: A sideloaded, ldid-signed build cannot obtain a valid APNs token for Telegram's push certificate, and Telegram's server would push to the official bundle id anyway; no path to a working token here.

name: Processing an APNs push payload in an extension
uiSurface: none, would need a notification service extension
rationale: iOS 6 has no notification service extensions and no mutable push content, and there is no valid push token in the first place.

name: VoIP push for incoming calls
uiSurface: none
rationale: PushKit does not exist on iOS 6, and the token problem above applies; incoming calls can only be caught while the socket is alive.

name: Local alerts driven by TDLib notification groups
uiSurface: UILocalNotification banners while backgrounded plus an in-app top banner while foregrounded
rationale: This is the only real notification path on this device: TDLib emits the groups over the live socket and we raise UILocalNotification ourselves. Needs update plumbing, a group-to-alert mapper, and a background-execution strategy since iOS 6 grants roughly ten minutes after backgrounding.

name: Dismissing notifications the user already read
uiSurface: none, called when a chat is opened
rationale: Two simple calls, but only worth doing once the local-alert path above exists.

name: Push message content rendering (preview text for each media type)
uiSurface: no screen: a formatter producing the alert body string
rationale: A pure switch over @type producing strings like 'Photo' or 'sent you a sticker'; reuses the same shape as the existing chat-list preview formatter.

name: Pending-notification keepalive hint
uiSurface: none
rationale: One update branch used to hold a UIBackgroundTask open a little longer before suspending.

name: Auto-archive and mute new chats from unknown users
uiSurface: two or three switch rows in a Privacy or Notifications section
rationale: Plain getter/setter with three booleans; archive list already exists in the client.

name: Forum topic notification settings
uiSurface: mute row on the topic list rows in TGTopicsViewController
rationale: Same chatNotificationSettings payload as chats with an extra topic id; the topics screen already exists.

name: In-app sounds, vibrate and in-app banner preferences
uiSurface: an 'In-App Notifications' section of local switches
rationale: Purely client-local (NSUserDefaults plus AudioServicesPlaySystemSound); TDLib only names the subsections for deep links, it stores nothing.

name: Service notifications from the server (including AUTH_KEY_DROP)
uiSurface: a TGAlertView, with Cancel plus Log Out buttons when the type begins with AUTH_KEY_DROP_
rationale: One update branch and an existing alert class; the log-out branch reuses the existing sign-out path.

name: Notification settings deep links (tg://settings/notifications subsections)
uiSurface: routing only, opens the relevant Notifications sub-page
rationale: Needs a general internal-link router that the client does not have yet; low value on its own.

name: Badge count and unread counters feeding the app icon
uiSurface: applicationIconBadgeNumber plus the chat list tab badge
rationale: Two update branches; local badge setting works fine on iOS 6 without any push entitlement.

name: Basic file download by id
uiSurface: no new UI; existing progress callback onFileProgress used by chat bubbles and avatars
rationale: TGClient.m:539 already wraps downloadFile with a completion and handles updateFile at line 312.

name: Cancel an in-flight download
uiSurface: tap-to-cancel X button on the media bubble's circular progress indicator, plus a cancel row in the download list
rationale: One-line send with file_id and only_if_pending:false; the progress ring already exists in the message cell.

name: Pause/resume individual download
uiSurface: pause/play glyph inside the progress ring and a swipe action in the downloads list
rationale: Single boolean call; only meaningful once a download list screen exists but works standalone on a bubble.

name: Pause/resume all downloads
uiSurface: single header button in the downloads screen
rationale: Parameterless boolean call, one button.

name: Add a message file to the downloads list
uiSurface: 'Save to Downloads' entry in the long-press message action sheet
rationale: Needs file_id + chat_id + message_id which the message cell already holds; UI is one action-sheet row.

name: Downloads list screen (active/paused/completed)
uiSurface: new UITableView screen with sections for active and completed, per-row progress bar, reached from Settings or a search-page tab
rationale: Whole new screen with paginated offset-string search, live per-row progress from four distinct updates, and 2013-style row layout to design.

name: Remove file(s) from downloads
uiSurface: row swipe-to-delete plus a 'Clear' button in the downloads screen
rationale: Simple calls; depends on the downloads screen existing but the wrappers are one method each.

name: Delete a downloaded file from local cache
uiSurface: 'Delete from cache' row in the media action sheet and in storage settings
rationale: One call by file_id, reverts local.path so the bubble falls back to thumbnail.

name: Re-fetch file state / refresh a stale file id
uiSurface: none, internal plumbing behind image loading
rationale: Plain request returning a file object; useful to resolve download state without starting a download.

name: Resolve a persistent remote file id
uiSurface: none, internal; enables caching remote ids across sessions since local int32 file ids are not stable
rationale: One request; matters if we persist ids in our own cache index.

name: Streaming download by byte range (partial download)
uiSurface: no direct UI; feeds an AVPlayer/AVAudioPlayer resource loader for play-while-downloading video and audio
rationale: Requires an offset/limit download loop plus an AVAssetResourceLoaderDelegate feeding partial bytes; substantial new plumbing, and on a 4S it is only worth it for audio and small MP4s.

name: Read arbitrary file bytes through TDLib
uiSurface: none, internal accessor
rationale: Only needed if files live outside our sandbox reach; normally we read local.path directly.

name: Suggested file name for saving/exporting
uiSurface: used in the 'Save' / share flow label
rationale: One call returning text.

name: Photo/document upload from the device
uiSurface: existing attachment sheet; add an upload progress ring and cancel on the outgoing bubble
rationale: inputFileLocal/inputMessagePhoto/inputMessageVideo are already wrapped; the missing part is surfacing remote.uploaded_size progress, which arrives on updateFile we already handle.

name: Upload progress and cancel for outgoing media
uiSurface: circular progress with an X over the outgoing photo/video bubble, 2013-style
rationale: Needs a message-id to file-id map and a new overlay control on outgoing bubbles; cancelling a sent-message upload actually means deleting the pending message.

name: Thumbnail rendering (photoSize / thumbnail)
uiSurface: message bubbles, media grid, avatars; pick the smallest photoSize that fits and downscale before display
rationale: Purely a matter of picking the right size from the photo sizes vector and calling the existing downloadFile; JPEG/PNG decode fine on iOS 6.

name: Minithumbnail blurred placeholder
uiSurface: instant blurred placeholder behind every photo/video bubble before the real thumb arrives
rationale: Bytes are a tiny JPEG that decodes fine, but needs a cheap blur/upscale path on a single-core A5 and a placeholder layer in the media cell; no CIFilter-quality blur available cheaply.

name: Animated thumbnail formats (tgs/webm/mpeg4/webp)
uiSurface: sticker and animation previews
rationale: iOS 6 has no WebP or WebM decoder and no Lottie/tgs renderer; MPEG4 thumb playback per-cell is beyond the 4S. Fall back to the static JPEG thumbnail instead.

name: Auto-download settings (photos/videos/files, per network type)
uiSurface: 'Auto-Download Media' settings screen: Wi-Fi / Cellular sections with toggles and size steppers, exactly a 2013 grouped table
rationale: Read presets, write a settings struct per network type; pure grouped-table UI with switches.

name: Network type reporting for correct auto-download
uiSurface: none, driven by Reachability at launch and on change
rationale: One call; iOS 6 Reachability distinguishes WWAN and WiFi, which is all TDLib needs.

name: Network usage statistics screen
uiSurface: 'Network Usage' grouped table listing bytes sent/received per file type, with a Reset button
rationale: Read-only aggregation into a static table plus one reset action.

name: Storage usage: fast size and full per-chat breakdown
uiSurface: existing storage row shows total; the per-chat breakdown list is a new table
rationale: getStorageStatisticsFast is wrapped (TGClient.m:1533); the full getStorageStatistics walks every file and is slow on a 4S, so the per-chat screen needs an async spinner and careful chat_limit.

name: Clear cache with filters (age, size, types, chats)
uiSurface: existing clear-cache action; could grow a 'Keep media for' picker and per-type checkboxes
rationale: optimizeStorage is already sent twice in TGClient.m; extending it with ttl and file_types is added dictionary keys plus an action sheet.

name: File generation protocol (client-side conversion)
uiSurface: none, background plumbing for re-encoding video/images before upload
rationale: Needs a generation handler keyed by generation_id and a conversion pipeline; useful for downscaling photos before upload, but real video transcode on a 4S via AVAssetExportSession is slow and must be opt-in.

name: MIME/extension/filename helpers
uiSurface: document row icon and label
rationale: Three trivial text-returning calls; can also be done locally, so low value.

name: Detect file type of an imported file head
uiSurface: import-messages flow only
rationale: Only useful for the chat-import feature, which needs a file picker and document access iOS 6 does not provide.

name: Application download link
uiSurface: an 'Invite friends' share text
rationale: One call returning an httpUrl to drop into a share sheet.

name: Saving media to the camera roll
uiSurface: 'Save Image'/'Save Video' rows in the media action sheet
rationale: After download, ALAssetsLibrary writeImageToSavedPhotosAlbum / writeVideoAtPathToSavedPhotosAlbum works on iOS 6.

name: Full-size photo viewer with progressive load
uiSurface: full-screen media viewer: thumbnail shown immediately, full size faded in on completion, pinch-zoom scroll view
rationale: New full-screen controller with zoom, progress overlay and strict downscaling to avoid blowing 512MB on a large JPEG.

name: Progressive JPEG sizes (progressive_sizes)
uiSurface: partial-render of a photo as bytes arrive in the viewer
rationale: Requires incremental JPEG decoding of arbitrary prefixes; CGImageSourceCreateIncremental on iOS 6 is unreliable for these progressive prefixes and the CPU cost on an A5 outweighs the benefit.

name: Translate a single message
uiSurface: "Translate" entry in the existing message long-press TGActionSheet in TGChatViewController, result shown in a TGAlertView or an inline expanded bubble
rationale: One TGClient wrapper returning formattedText; the minimal presentation (action sheet entry plus alert/label) needs no new layout, and works for free accounts.

name: Inline translated-text bubble under original message
uiSurface: ChatViewCell gains a second text block plus a "Show original"/"Translate" footer row, with per-message translated state cached
rationale: Requires real cell layout changes, height recalculation and per-message state, not just a sheet.

name: Translate arbitrary text (input field, bios, captions)
uiSurface: Optional "Translate" action on selected text / composer, result in TGAlertView
rationale: Plain request-response with a string in and a string out.

name: Translation tone selection (formal / neutral / casual)
uiSurface: Extra TGActionSheet with three tone options before translating, or a settings default
rationale: Just an extra string parameter on the same call, exposed as a three-button sheet.

name: Target-language picker for translation
uiSurface: Grouped table of languages pushed from Settings and from the translate sheet; stores chosen code in NSUserDefaults
rationale: A single table of language names from getLocalizationTargetInfo plus a persisted code; no new control types.

name: Per-chat "Translate this chat" bar
uiSurface: A dismissible bar under the chat navigation bar in TGChatViewController plus batch translation of visible messages
rationale: New persistent header UI, batching and caching of many translate calls, and it is a Telegram Premium feature (premiumFeatureRealTimeChatTranslation) so free accounts will get errors.

name: Show Translate Button setting
uiSurface: UISwitch row in a new Language section of TGSettingsViewController
rationale: Local preference gating whether the translate entry appears; one switch row.

name: Do Not Translate language list
uiSurface: Multi-select checkmark table pushed from the Language settings section, stored locally
rationale: Client-side exclusion list; a checkmark table over the same language list.

name: Speech recognition of voice notes
uiSurface: Small transcribe glyph on the voice-note bubble; transcript text appended inside the cell, updated as pending -> text
rationale: Server does the work so the 4S is fine, but the cell must grow a button, a pending state and a variable-height transcript, and updates arrive asynchronously via updateMessageContent.

name: Speech recognition of video notes
uiSurface: Same transcribe affordance on the round video-note cell
rationale: Identical plumbing to voice notes but on the circular video-note cell added in a recent commit; shares the transcript layout work.

name: Rate a speech transcription
uiSurface: Two-option action sheet (Good / Bad) after a transcript is shown
rationale: One boolean call behind an action sheet, once transcripts exist.

name: Speech recognition free-trial counter
uiSurface: Footer text under the transcript or an alert when the weekly quota is exhausted
rationale: Cache the update payload and render remaining count as a label; no new screen.

name: Interface language list and switching
uiSurface: "Language" row in TGSettingsViewController pushing a checkmark table of installed/official packs; setOption "language_pack_id" applies
rationale: Table plus one setOption; the hard part is only that our UI strings are hardcoded English, which does not block the switching mechanism itself.

name: Applying language pack strings to our own UI
uiSurface: No screen: a TGLang lookup layer replacing every hardcoded literal across all view controllers
rationale: Requires a key-mapping layer, pluralisation handling and a sweep of every hardcoded string in src/; substantial client plumbing rather than a screen.

name: Language pack synchronisation and local database path
uiSurface: Invisible; a pull-to-refresh or automatic call after choosing a language
rationale: Single fire-and-forget call; getLanguagePackString is synchronous against the TDLib db path we already configure.

name: Language pack deep links (t.me/setlanguage)
uiSurface: Confirmation TGAlertView on tapping such a link, then apply
rationale: Fits our existing link-handling path; three chained calls behind one alert.

name: Custom / translator-platform language packs
uiSurface: A translation-authoring screen listing keys with editable values
rationale: An in-app translation editor over thousands of keys is unusable on a 3.5-inch 512MB device and the real client sends users to translations.telegram.org in a browser; no value here.

name: RTL language support
uiSurface: Mirrored layout across chat list, chat bubbles and navigation
rationale: iOS 6 has no semantic-direction layout attributes and we are frame-based only, so mirroring would mean hand-flipping every frame in the app; not worth it and the 2014 client did not do it either.

name: Channel automatic translation for viewers
uiSurface: Switch row in channel admin settings
rationale: Only meaningful for channel owners whose channel has the required boost level; we have no channel-admin screens and the payoff is nil for this client.

name: Premium real-time chat translation upsell
uiSurface: Premium feature list entry
rationale: Needs an active Telegram Premium subscription and an in-app purchase flow that iOS 6 StoreKit here cannot complete; surface the error instead.

name: Authorization state machine driving login flow
uiSurface: root login navigation controller that swaps step screens; our existing login flow
rationale: TGClient already wraps getAuthorizationState/setTdlibParameters and routes updates; only the missing states below need new screens.

name: Phone number entry with country picker and code type hints
uiSurface: country list table + phone field on login screen (sendPhoneNumber: exists but hardcodes settings, no country list)
rationale: Country list, calling-code prefix and live formatting is a real new screen plus formatting plumbing, though the TDLib side is two calls.

name: Login code entry, code type display and timeout
uiSurface: code field + 'we sent a code via X' label and countdown on login screen
rationale: sendCode: already exists; only the code_info label/countdown rendering is new and it is a label plus timer.

name: Resend code / request call / report code missing
uiSurface: 'Send code again' / 'Call me' buttons under the code field
rationale: One-line TGClient wrapper each, buttons already fit the login screen.

name: Two-step verification password at login, with hint
uiSurface: password screen with hint label; login flow
rationale: sendPassword: already wrapped; only the hint/recovery-pattern labels are missing.

name: Password recovery at login via recovery email
uiSurface: 'Forgot password' link -> code entry -> new password screens on login flow
rationale: Three-step wizard with new-password confirmation; new screens, though each call is trivial.

name: New-user registration (first/last name, terms of service)
uiSurface: name entry screen + ToS alert on login flow
rationale: Needs a new signup screen and a ToS popup path we currently do not have at all; without it new accounts cannot sign in.

name: Log out
uiSurface: destructive row + confirm action sheet in Settings
rationale: Fully wrapped; only the confirmation sheet wiring.

name: Log in by scanning a QR code shown on another device
uiSurface: reuse the existing QR scanner screen, then a confirm sheet naming the device
rationale: We already shipped a QR scanner; this is one wrapper plus a confirmation alert.

name: Log in on this device by displaying a QR code
uiSurface: full-screen QR image on the login screen, refreshed when the link changes
rationale: Requires a QR encoder (none on iOS 6, must be bundled/written) and a refreshing full-screen view.

name: Login email address (email as second factor at sign-in)
uiSurface: email entry + email code screens, plus a 'reset email' countdown row, on login flow
rationale: Only the plain emailAddressAuthenticationCode branch is reachable; still two new screens plus reset-timer state.

name: Sign in with Apple ID / Google ID during login
uiSurface: buttons on the email screen
rationale: No Sign in with Apple or Google SDK exists for iOS 6; the token cannot be obtained on a 4S.

name: Firebase SMS device verification
uiSurface: none, silent
rationale: Requires a valid APNs push receipt for the app bundle; we have no push registration and no matching APNs entitlement on a sideloaded legacy build.

name: Passkey / WebAuthn login and web-token login
uiSurface: button on login screen
rationale: iOS 6 has no AuthenticationServices/passkey support and no WKWebView to run the web token flow.

name: Premium-purchase-gated authorization
uiSurface: paywall screen
rationale: Needs a live App Store StoreKit purchase tied to the modern Telegram product id; unreachable from this build.

name: Two-step verification setup: enable, change and disable password
uiSurface: Privacy and Security section: 'Two-Step Verification' row -> password/hint entry screens
rationale: Multi-field wizard (new password, confirm, hint, optional recovery email) and a state screen; more than a toggle.

name: Recovery email address management
uiSurface: row inside Two-Step Verification showing masked email + edit/verify screens
rationale: Requires the password-state screen to exist first plus a code confirmation step.

name: Password recovery and account password reset from settings
uiSurface: 'Forgot password' / 'Reset password' rows with pending-date label
rationale: Shares the recovery wizard; pending/declined states need date-formatted status rows.

name: Login email address change from settings
uiSurface: row in Two-Step Verification showing login_email_address_pattern + edit screen
rationale: New entry/verify screens hanging off the password-state screen.

name: Active sessions list with device, app, IP, location and dates
uiSurface: 'Active Sessions' table in Privacy and Security; current session header + others
rationale: sessionsWithCompletion: already wrapped; it is a grouped table of labels.

name: Terminate one session / terminate all other sessions
uiSurface: swipe-to-delete row and a destructive 'Terminate All Other Sessions' button
rationale: terminateSession: is wrapped; terminateAllOtherSessions is a one-method addition.

name: Per-session permissions: accept calls, accept secret chats
uiSurface: two switches on a session detail screen
rationale: Two boolean wrappers plus a small detail screen of toggles.

name: Unconfirmed new-login banner and session confirmation
uiSurface: banner over the chat list with Confirm / Terminate actions
rationale: Needs a persistent banner surface driven by an update, similar to our existing undo banner but new plumbing.

name: Auto-terminate inactive sessions after N days
uiSurface: 'Terminate Old Sessions' row with a value picker action sheet
rationale: One setter and a choice sheet.

name: Account self-destruct timer
uiSurface: 'If Away For' row with choice sheet in Privacy and Security
rationale: Both calls already wrapped in TGClient.

name: Delete account with reason and password
uiSurface: destructive row, reason text field, password prompt alert
rationale: Single call; UI is an alert chain, though it must be guarded behind a strong confirmation.

name: Change own phone number
uiSurface: 'Change Number' flow reusing the phone entry and code entry screens from login
rationale: Reuses login screens but needs them factored out of the login controller into reusable pieces.

name: Edit own name and bio
uiSurface: Edit Profile fields
rationale: setName and setBio are already wrapped and getMe is available.

name: Own username set and availability check
uiSurface: username field with live green/red availability label
rationale: setUsername:completion: exists; adding the live check is one call plus a label.

name: Multiple usernames: activate/deactivate and reorder
uiSurface: list of usernames with per-row toggle and drag reorder in Edit Profile
rationale: Editing-mode table with reordering; UITableView reorder on iOS 6 works but the screen is genuinely new.

name: Own profile photo set and delete
uiSurface: avatar tap -> action sheet (take photo / choose / delete) in Edit Profile
rationale: Needs image picker, downscaling before upload on a 512MB device, and file upload plumbing.

name: Public profile link (t.me/username) and login by token
uiSurface: 'Share my link' row with copy/share sheet on the profile screen
rationale: One call returning a URL string; UI is a row plus copy.

name: Own profile QR code
uiSurface: full-screen QR sheet from the profile screen
rationale: Same missing QR encoder as the login QR; the image must be generated locally.

name: Birthdate on own profile
uiSurface: date row with UIDatePicker in Edit Profile
rationale: One setter, standard UIDatePicker available on iOS 6.

name: Personal chat shown on own profile
uiSurface: row opening a channel picker in Edit Profile
rationale: One setter; picker can reuse the existing chat selection screen.

name: Profile accent color and emoji status
uiSurface: color swatch grid on Edit Profile
rationale: Depends on premium-gated colors and animated custom emoji rendering that our 2013-style design deliberately does not have.

name: Profile audio (profile song)
uiSurface: audio list on Edit Profile
rationale: Premium-only modern feature requiring media picker plus streaming playback on the profile; not worth 4S budget and gated server-side.

name: Hide sponsored messages
uiSurface: single toggle in Settings
rationale: Toggle is one call but it only takes effect for Premium subscribers.

name: Email address verification (generic, used by passport/support)
uiSurface: email + code screens
rationale: Three simple wrappers; screens reuse the login email pattern once that exists.

name: Telegram Passport data and authorization forms
uiSurface: whole passport section with document scanning and upload
rationale: Enormous document-capture UI plus client-side encryption; disproportionate for a 4S port and rarely used.

name: Temporary password for wallet/withdrawal confirmations
uiSurface: password prompt before payment actions
rationale: Only meaningful for the payments/withdrawal flows, which are out of scope on this client.

name: Preferred country language for the login screen
uiSurface: invisible; picks localisation after country selection
rationale: One call, no UI beyond triggering the existing localisation load.

name: Fast storage overview (total size + file count)
uiSurface: Header label with total cache size on the existing Storage and cache screen (TGStorageViewController)
rationale: Already wrapped as -storageStatsWithCompletion: and rendered; only unused fields (database_size, language_pack_database_size, log_size) remain to surface as extra rows.

name: Database / language pack / log size breakdown
uiSurface: Three extra static value rows in a 'Local database' section of the storage screen
rationale: Same single call already made; the wrapper just discards database_size, language_pack_database_size and log_size today.

name: Exact storage usage by file type
uiSurface: Per-category size labels on the existing three clear rows (Photos / Video / Documents) of the storage screen
rationale: One new TGClient method with chat_limit 0, aggregate by_chat[0].by_file_type into buckets; the UI rows already exist and just need a detail label.

name: Storage usage by chat (top offenders list)
uiSurface: New scrolling list of chats sorted by cache size with avatar, title, size, and per-chat clear action
rationale: Needs a new screen, avatar loading, sorting, per-row selection state and per-chat optimizeStorage(chat_ids:) plumbing; getStorageStatistics with a chat_limit is also slow on a 4S so it needs a spinner/async design.

name: Clear cache by file-type category
uiSurface: Existing rows + confirm action sheet on the storage screen
rationale: Fully implemented via -clearCacheOfTypes:completion:; only extra categories (stickers, wallpapers, secret thumbnails excluded by TDLib) would be added.

name: Clear entire cache
uiSurface: Destructive 'Clear everything' row with confirmation on the storage screen
rationale: Already present; consider passing an explicit full file_types list instead of a bare optimizeStorage so behaviour is deterministic.

name: Keep media for (cache TTL) setting
uiSurface: Action sheet picking 3 days / 1 week / 1 month / forever, stored in NSUserDefaults, applied on launch via optimizeStorage ttl:
rationale: TDLib has no persistent TTL setting; the client stores the choice and calls optimizeStorage with that ttl at startup - one wrapper method plus one action sheet.

name: Maximum cache size setting
uiSurface: Action sheet picking 5 GB / 16 GB / 32 GB / No limit, persisted locally, applied via optimizeStorage size:
rationale: Same shape as TTL: client-side preference passed as the size argument at launch; no new UI beyond a value row and sheet.

name: Immunity delay / exclude chats from cleanup
uiSurface: Multi-select chat picker feeding exclude_chat_ids, plus a toggle for recently-used immunity
rationale: Requires a persistent exclusion list, a chat multi-picker screen and merging that list into every optimizeStorage call.

name: Database statistics (debug)
uiSurface: A monospaced scrollable text view behind a debug row on the storage screen
rationale: Returns a single preformatted string; one wrapper and a UITextView pushed on a plain view controller.

name: Delete a single cached file
uiSurface: 'Delete from cache' entry in the media/document long-press action sheet in a chat
rationale: One-line send with file_id; the message action sheet already exists to hang it on.

name: Download / cancel download of a file
uiSurface: Progress ring on media bubbles; tap to cancel
rationale: downloadFile is wrapped but cancelDownloadFile is not, and cancel needs per-bubble progress state and a tappable cancel affordance in ChatViewCell.

name: Downloads manager (list of active/paused/completed downloads)
uiSurface: New Downloads screen reachable from search or settings: rows with filename, progress bar, pause/resume, swipe-to-remove, plus a pause-all button
rationale: Genuinely new screen with live update handling for four update types and paging via next_offset; substantial plumbing.

name: Add file from a message to the download list
uiSurface: 'Save to downloads' entry in the message action sheet
rationale: Single call taking file_id/chat_id/message_id, all already available at the message action sheet call site.

name: Auto-download settings (photos/video/files, per network type)
uiSurface: Three sub-screens (Using Wi-Fi / Using mobile data / Roaming) each with toggles and size sliders, under Data and Storage
rationale: Needs a settings sub-screen per network type with size pickers, plus tracking that TDLib gives no getter for current settings so values must be mirrored locally.

name: Network usage statistics
uiSurface: 'Network usage' screen with sent/received totals grouped by media type and by Wi-Fi vs mobile, plus a reset row
rationale: New screen aggregating a vector of heterogeneous entries into a readable table; not just a row, but no exotic APIs.

name: Report network type to TDLib for correct stats and auto-download
uiSurface: No UI; reachability observer in AppDelegate/TGClient
rationale: One send call driven by SCNetworkReachability, which iOS 6 fully supports; prerequisite for meaningful network stats and auto-download.

name: Suggested filename / MIME type helpers for saving files
uiSurface: Used silently when exporting a document via the share sheet
rationale: Synchronous-style helper calls; no dedicated UI of their own.

name: Partial download prefix size (streaming readiness)
uiSurface: Would drive a 'ready to play' state on voice/video bubbles
rationale: Only useful for streaming playback; the 4S has no practical way to stream-decode video and our player requires a complete local file, so this buys nothing.

name: Native data-and-storage settings deep links
uiSurface: tg://settings/storage links opening our storage screen
rationale: Just a subsection string match routed to the existing TGStorageViewController when a settings link is opened.

name: Automatic background cache trimming on low disk
uiSurface: No UI; runs on didReceiveMemoryWarning / app launch, optional snackbar afterwards
rationale: Both calls are wrapped; on a 512MB 4S with a small disk this is arguably the single most valuable storage feature and costs one launch-time hook.

name: Per-chat 'Clear cache' from chat profile
uiSurface: A 'Clear cache (N MB)' row in TGProfileViewController for a chat
rationale: Reuses the same two calls with chat_ids set to one chat; the profile screen already has an action-row pattern.

name: Link preview bubble in chat messages
uiSurface: new left-accent-bar attachment view inside the message bubble (site name, title, description, thumbnail) in TGChatViewController message cells
rationale: messageText already carries link_preview inline so no extra TDLib call is needed, but the bubble needs a whole new measured sublayout plus thumbnail download and cache, and our cells currently render no entities at all.

name: Large-media vs small-media preview layout
uiSurface: layout variant switch inside the link preview view (thumb on the right vs full-width image above text)
rationale: has_large_media/show_large_media/show_media_above_description drive two distinct frame layouts that must be computed in the cell height pass.

name: Tappable text entities (url, textUrl, email, phone, mention, hashtag, bank card)
uiSurface: hit-testable link runs in the message text label plus a long-press action sheet (Open, Copy, Add to Reading List)
rationale: prerequisite for every other item here and nothing in src/ touches entities today; on iOS 6 there is no NSAttributedString-in-UILabel link hit testing, so we need a CoreText-based custom label with manual run rectangles.

name: Link tap routing: internal vs external
uiSurface: no visible UI of its own: a central TGLinkRouter that dispatches to existing chat/profile/sticker screens or to Safari
rationale: one TDLib call but a real dispatch layer with ~40 link-type cases and navigation plumbing into every existing controller.

name: Open external HTTP link with confirmation
uiSurface: UIActionSheet confirmation showing the domain, then [UIApplication openURL:]
rationale: two one-line request wrappers and a pre-iOS-7 UIAlertView/UIActionSheet; skip_confirmation short-circuits straight to openURL.

name: Login-URL keyboard buttons (Seamless Telegram Login)
uiSurface: confirmation alert with the bot name and an optional 'allow write access' checkbox row, then opens Safari
rationale: pure request/alert flow; only meaningful once inline keyboards exist, but the web-link half is a couple of methods.

name: tg:// unknown deep link handling
uiSurface: alert with server-supplied text and an optional 'Update App' button
rationale: getDeepLinkInfo returns formatted text plus need_update_application; a single alert covers it.

name: Copy message link / permalink to a message
uiSurface: 'Copy Link' row in the existing message long-press action sheet
rationale: one request, result string goes to UIPasteboard; only valid for public chats, so gate the row on chat username presence.

name: Open a t.me message link (resolve to chat + scroll to message)
uiSurface: pushes the existing chat controller and jumps to the message id
rationale: the call is trivial but 'open chat at a specific message id' needs history-around loading and scroll anchoring our chat controller does not have yet.

name: Public username / t.me/username resolution
uiSurface: pushes profile or chat screen; draft_text pre-fills the composer
rationale: searchPublicChat and searchUserByPhoneNumber are already wrapped in TGClient.m; only the routing branch and optional draft prefill are new.

name: Chat invite links (t.me/+hash, joinchat)
uiSurface: modal join sheet with chat photo, title, member count and a Join button
rationale: needs a small new modal screen with avatar and member preview; the two TDLib calls are simple but the sheet is genuinely new UI.

name: Instant View article reader (v1 text blocks)
uiSurface: a full-screen native reader controller: UITableView of heterogeneous block cells with a top-right share button
rationale: absolutely doable without WKWebView because TDLib hands us structured blocks, but it is a whole new screen with a per-block layout engine and CoreText rich-text rendering; the single biggest item in this area.

name: Instant View rich text renderer
uiSurface: shared CoreText attributed-string builder used by every Instant View block and by the message text label
rationale: recursive RichText tree to NSAttributedString plus tappable ranges; must be built once and reused, and iOS 6 CoreText needs manual font/underline attribute mapping.

name: Instant View media blocks (photo, animation, video, collage, slideshow, cover)
uiSurface: image cells inside the reader with a caption strip; slideshow uses a paged UIScrollView
rationale: downloadFile is already wrapped, but full-bleed article images must be downscaled before display on a 512MB 4S and a slideshow pager is new UI.

name: Instant View embedded content blocks (YouTube, tweets, iframes)
uiSurface: a UIWebView pane inside the reader, or a poster image that opens the URL in Safari
rationale: the supplied html is modern JS that iOS 6 UIWebView cannot run, and current YouTube/Twitter embeds require TLS and JS features the 4S stack does not support; render the poster photo and hand the URL to Safari instead.

name: Instant View v2 blocks (tables, collapsible details, related articles, kicker, section headings)
uiSurface: horizontally scrolling table view, expandable disclosure rows, and a related-articles list at the article end
rationale: tables need a bespoke colspan/rowspan grid measurer with its own horizontal scroll; realistic only as a second pass after v1 blocks land.

name: Instant View map block
uiSurface: static map thumbnail inside the reader
rationale: MKMapSnapshotter is iOS 7+ and an offscreen MKMapView render on a 4S is slow and memory hungry; fall back to a tappable placeholder that opens Maps.

name: Instant View footer chrome (view count, feedback link, share)
uiSurface: view-count label and a 'Leave a comment' footer row plus a share action sheet in the reader nav bar
rationale: plain labels and one action sheet, once the reader controller from the Instant View item exists.

name: 'Instant View' button on link preview bubbles
uiSurface: a full-width button strip at the bottom of the link preview bubble that pushes the reader
rationale: gated on instant_view_version > 0; one button row plus a push, given the reader and preview bubble exist.

name: Composer link preview panel
uiSurface: a preview strip above the input bar with a close (x) button while typing a URL
rationale: needs debounce on text change, an animated panel above the composer, and threading link_preview_options through our existing inputMessageText send path.

name: Link preview options: disable, force small/large, show above text
uiSurface: action sheet from the composer preview strip with three toggles
rationale: just extra keys on the inputMessageText dictionary TGClient.m already builds, plus an action sheet.

name: Non-article link preview types rendered as media (photo, video, sticker, document, audio, voice)
uiSurface: reuses the existing photo/video/document/voice attachment views inside the preview bubble
rationale: once the preview bubble container exists, each of these just embeds a media view we already render for real messages.

name: External audio/video link playback (linkPreviewTypeExternalVideo/Audio)
uiSurface: tap the preview to open MPMoviePlayerViewController
rationale: MPMoviePlayerViewController exists on iOS 6, but only plain http(s) progressive MP4/AAC decodes on a 4S; needs mime sniffing and a graceful bail to Safari.

name: Handling incoming tg:// and t.me URLs from other apps
uiSurface: app delegate openURL entry point feeding the link router; no visible UI
rationale: needs Info.plist URL scheme registration, a cold-start queue until authorization completes, and the router from the link-tap item.

name: Sharing a chat/bot/game/sticker set as a t.me link
uiSurface: 'Copy Link' / 'Share' rows in profile and sticker set screens
rationale: one wrapper taking an InternalLinkType dict and is_http, result to UIPasteboard or a UIActivityViewController style sheet.

name: Recently visited t.me URLs
uiSurface: a suggestions section in the global search screen
rationale: single request, result maps straight onto the existing search results table.

name: Message embedding code and app download link
uiSurface: 'Copy Embed Code' row in the message action sheet; download link used in the invite-friends flow
rationale: both return a plain Text/HttpUrl that goes to the pasteboard or an SMS body.

name: Telegram Mini Apps / Web Apps opened from links
uiSurface: would need a full-screen web container with a JS bridge
rationale: Mini Apps require WKWebView with a postMessage bridge and modern ES6/TLS support; iOS 6 only has UIWebView and its JS engine plus certificate stack cannot run today's telegram-web-app.js, so these links should show 'not supported in this app' and offer Safari.

name: Instant View local cache / offline read
uiSurface: none, just the only_local flag on the reader load path
rationale: pass only_local:true first for an instant render, then refresh from network; a one-line branch inside the reader loader.

name: App theme selection (light/dark/classic)
uiSurface: Settings > Appearance: table with theme rows + checkmark, applied through our TGTheme; purely local, no TDLib
rationale: TDLib has no client theme storage for us; this is entirely our own TGTheme plumbing plus a full repaint path across every screen, which is real client work.

name: Chat wallpaper: list installed backgrounds
uiSurface: Settings > Chat Background: grid/thumbnail picker; on iOS 6 a plain UITableView of downscaled preview rows is safer than a grid
rationale: Needs a new picker screen, thumbnail file downloads through our file pipeline and memory-safe downscaling on a 512MB device.

name: Set / clear default chat background
uiSurface: Row action + confirm in the background picker; result must repaint TGChatViewController message-list backdrop
rationale: The call itself is one method, but wiring a wallpaper image behind the chat transcript (tiling, scroll perf, memory) is genuinely new client plumbing.

name: Solid-color / gradient wallpaper (no image download)
uiSurface: Colour swatch list row in the background picker
rationale: A solid fill needs no file download and no decoding; it is a colour table plus one setDefaultBackground wrapper, cheap even on a 4S.

name: Freeform multi-point gradient and animated pattern wallpapers
uiSurface: Same picker, animated fill layer
rationale: Four-point animated mesh gradients and animated SVG pattern masks need per-frame GPU compositing that the single-core A5 with no Metal cannot sustain behind a scrolling table.

name: Search background by name / background deep link
uiSurface: Handled from a t.me/bg/... link, plus a share-link action sheet item on the current wallpaper
rationale: Two straight request wrappers feeding an existing action-sheet/share path.

name: Per-chat theme (emoji themes)
uiSurface: Chat info screen row opening a horizontal emoji-theme strip
rationale: Setting is one call, but rendering per-chat palettes means our TGTheme must become chat-scoped, which touches every chat view.

name: Gift chat themes
uiSurface: Extra tab in the chat-theme picker
rationale: Requires owned gift NFTs and Stars-era account state that this client cannot obtain; the themes also rely on animated backdrops we cannot render.

name: Accent colour / profile accent colour for own account
uiSurface: Settings > Appearance colour swatch row
rationale: Name/profile accent colours beyond the default palette are a Premium-gated server feature and the accompanying custom-emoji backdrops cannot be rendered here.

name: Auto-download presets (low/medium/high)
uiSurface: Settings > Data and Storage: three-row preset chooser with checkmark
rationale: One request returning three ready structs rendered as a checkmark table.

name: Auto-download settings per network type
uiSurface: Two sub-screens (Using Wi-Fi / Using Mobile) of toggles and size steppers
rationale: Plain toggle-and-slider table over a single setter; matches the classic 2013 Data Settings screen exactly.

name: Report network type to TDLib
uiSurface: No UI; called from reachability changes in TGClient
rationale: One send from the existing reachability hook; also makes the auto-download presets behave correctly.

name: Network usage statistics + reset
uiSurface: Settings > Data and Storage > Network Usage: grouped value rows plus a destructive reset row
rationale: Read-only aggregation into a static table and one reset action sheet.

name: Autosave media to gallery settings
uiSurface: Settings > Data and Storage > Save to Camera Roll: three scope rows with toggles
rationale: Simple toggle table over two calls; actual saving uses ALAssetsLibrary which exists on iOS 6.

name: Storage usage: fast stats and full per-chat stats
uiSurface: Settings > Data and Storage > Storage Usage: total size header plus per-chat rows
rationale: getStorageStatisticsFast is already wrapped in TGClient.m; adding the per-chat variant is one more request and a table.

name: Clear cache / cache TTL
uiSurface: Destructive 'Clear Cache' row + 'Keep Media' TTL chooser (3 days / 1 week / 1 month / forever)
rationale: optimizeStorage is already sent from TGClient.m; only the TTL/file-type parameters and an action sheet are missing.

name: Archive settings (auto-archive unknown senders, keep unmuted/folder chats archived)
uiSurface: Archived Chats screen > gear item, or Settings > Privacy: three toggle rows
rationale: Exactly three booleans over a getter and a setter.

name: Suggested actions banner (set password, check phone number, enable archive-and-mute)
uiSurface: Dismissible header cell at the top of the chat list, tapping routes to the relevant settings screen
rationale: Needs a new dismissible header cell with its own layout and routing table, not a plain settings row.

name: Premium-related suggested actions
uiSurface: Would be the same chat-list banner
rationale: These lead to in-app purchase and Stars flows that require a current App Store receipt path and Premium server state unavailable to this client; they must simply be filtered out.

name: Application config JSON
uiSurface: No UI; feature flags consumed by TGCapabilities
rationale: One request plus JsonValue unwrapping into an NSDictionary, useful to gate features we cannot support.

name: TDLib options read/write (per-user limits, flags)
uiSurface: No UI; internal, plus a hidden debug list
rationale: getOption and setOption are already used in TGClient.m; extending to arbitrary keys is trivial.

name: Interface language selection
uiSurface: Settings > Language: table of languages with checkmark
rationale: getLocalizationTargetInfo is already wrapped, but actually applying a language pack means routing all our hardcoded UI strings through a lookup layer that does not exist yet.

name: Custom local language pack (translation platform)
uiSurface: Deep-link entry from t.me/setlanguage
rationale: Depends on the full string-lookup layer plus deep-link handling; no value for a legacy client and would double the localisation work.

name: App update / download link and deep-link info
uiSurface: Alert shown when an unsupported deep link is opened; 'need to update' text
rationale: Both return simple strings shown in a TGAlertView, and getDeepLinkInfo is the correct fallback for every link type we cannot handle.

name: Custom notification sounds library
uiSurface: Settings > Notifications > Sound: list of built-in and saved sounds
rationale: Listing is easy, but downloading, converting and actually playing arbitrary saved sounds as local-notification tones is not possible on iOS 6 without bundled caf files, so only in-app playback is realistic and needs its own screen.

name: Scope notification settings (private / group / channel defaults)
uiSurface: Settings > Notifications: three sections of toggles and preview switches
rationale: Classic 2013 Notifications screen shape: toggles over one getter and one setter per scope.

name: Default background custom-emoji stickers / themed emoji statuses
uiSurface: Custom-emoji backdrop picker in profile appearance
rationale: Animated custom emoji require TGS/lottie rendering that a 4S cannot do at acceptable frame rates, and emoji statuses are Premium-only.

name: Reset all chat backgrounds / theme back to default
uiSurface: 'Reset' destructive row at the bottom of the appearance screen
rationale: Two existing calls behind one confirm action sheet.

name: Proxy list screen (added proxies, enable/disable)
uiSurface: Grouped table of proxy rows with a checkmark on the enabled one plus a master 'Use proxy' switch; new Proxy Settings screen pushed from TGSettingsViewController
rationale: getProxies returns a flat list and enable/disable/remove are single-argument calls reachable through TGClient's generic request:completion:, and the screen is a plain UITableView.

name: Add / edit proxy (SOCKS5, HTTP, MTProto)
uiSurface: Form screen with type selector, server, port, username, password or MTProto secret fields and a Save bar button; pushed from the proxy list
rationale: A multi-field keyboard form with per-type field visibility, validation and a type switch is genuinely new UI, not a row or a sheet.

name: Proxy latency ping
uiSurface: Detail text on each proxy row showing 'checking...' then 'NNN ms' or 'unavailable', refreshed when the list appears
rationale: One call per row whose double result is rendered into the existing cell detail label.

name: Connection state indicator in the title bar
uiSurface: Navigation-bar title swapping to 'Connecting...' / 'Updating...' / 'Waiting for network' with a small spinner, on chat list and inside chats
rationale: TGClient.m already parses updateConnectionState and exposes onConnectionState; only TGChatListViewController consumes it today, so this is wiring an existing signal into more title views.

name: Distinct 'Connecting to proxy' state
uiSurface: Same title-bar indicator with separate wording when a proxy is in use
rationale: TGClient currently folds connectionStateConnectingToProxy into TGConnectionStateConnecting; splitting it is one enum case and one string.

name: Report actual network type to TDLib
uiSurface: No UI; an SCNetworkReachability observer in AppDelegate/TGClient pushing the current type on change and on foreground
rationale: SystemConfiguration reachability works on iOS 6 and distinguishes WWAN from WiFi; the call is one string enum and it is what makes per-network stats and auto-download meaningful.

name: Network usage statistics screen
uiSurface: Grouped table of sent/received bytes per file type and for calls, split mobile vs WiFi, with a destructive 'Reset statistics' row and a 'since date' footer; next to TGStorageViewController
rationale: The response is a flat entry vector aggregated client-side into table rows, and the reset confirm sheet pattern already exists in the storage screen.

name: Contribute call traffic to network statistics
uiSurface: No UI; called from TGCall when a voice call ends
rationale: Our calls run over our own libtgvoip path so TDLib never sees that traffic; one call at hangup with counters we already have makes the stats honest.

name: Auto-download settings per network type
uiSurface: Two sub-screens (Mobile / Wi-Fi) of toggles for photos, videos and other files plus size limits, under Data and Storage
rationale: Reading presets and writing a whole settings struct per network type needs a real settings screen with limit pickers, and our download path must actually honour the flags.

name: Use less data for calls
uiSurface: Single toggle row in call settings flipping use_less_data_for_calls
rationale: The flag is trivial but only means anything if our libtgvoip bridge reads it and lowers the opus bitrate, which is real plumbing in TGCall.

name: Open tg://proxy links to add a proxy
uiSurface: Confirmation alert 'Add this proxy?' from a URL-scheme open in AppDelegate or a tapped proxy link in a message
rationale: getInternalLinkType returns a ready proxy object fed straight into addProxy behind a TGAlertView, and the URL hook already exists.

name: Share a proxy as a t.me link
uiSurface: Share row or long-press action sheet on a proxy row that copies the generated link to the pasteboard
rationale: One call returning an httpUrl string plus a copy action sheet, both patterns already in the app.

name: Scan a proxy QR code
uiSurface: Bar button on the proxy list reusing TGQRViewController, then the same add-proxy confirmation
rationale: The quirc scanner and its controller already ship; this is one entry point plus the existing link-to-proxy path.

name: Use proxy for calls
uiSurface: Toggle row at the bottom of the proxy list
rationale: setOption is wrapped, but our calls bypass TDLib networking entirely (TGCallReflector/TGCallIce open their own sockets), so honouring it means teaching our call transport to dial through SOCKS5/MTProto.

name: Test a proxy against a datacenter before saving
uiSurface: No dedicated screen; the validation step in the add-proxy form
rationale: A single call with a timeout whose ok/error result drives an inline 'checking / connected / failed' label.

name: Sponsored-by-proxy chat badge
uiSurface: 'Proxy sponsor' caption line on the promoted chat row in the chat list
rationale: The chat list already renders rows; this is one source check and a small label when an MTProto proxy injects a sponsored channel.

name: Waiting-for-network banner
uiSurface: TGSnackbar or a thin bar under the navigation bar reading 'Waiting for network'
rationale: The state already arrives and TGSnackbar exists, so this is presentation only.

name: Connection diagnostics / app config debug screen
uiSurface: Hidden debug screen reachable by long-pressing the settings version footer, listing raw key/value rows
rationale: All read-only calls rendered as plain text rows; valuable for diagnosing proxy and connection problems on a device with no debugger attached.

name: Proxy auto-rotation (pick the fastest reachable proxy)
uiSurface: No new screen; background logic plus a toggle on the proxy list
rationale: Not a TDLib feature but client policy: needs a ping scheduler, failure backoff and care not to burn battery or wake the radio on a 4S.

name: Data saver master switch
uiSurface: Single 'Data Saver' toggle in Data and Storage applying the low preset to every network type
rationale: One toggle fanning out to three setAutoDownloadSettings calls with the low preset already returned by getAutoDownloadSettingsPresets.
